LaST0.5: A Generalist World Action Model with Interaction-Centric Latent Reasoning WorldModel

World Action Model Interaction-Centric Latent Reasoning Mixture-of-Transformers Robotic Manipulation Long-Horizon Execution

简要说明：LaST0.5是一种用于机器人操作的世界动作模型，引入以交互为中心的潜在推理空间，更好地捕捉机器人与物体的交互，桥接世界模型和动作生成，在LIBERO和RLBench上达到最先进水平，并展示了真实世界中的长时程和灵巧操作。

TLDR: LaST0.5 is a World Action Model for robotic manipulation that introduces an interaction-centric latent reasoning space to better capture robot-object interactions, bridging world models and action generation, achieving state-of-the-art results on LIBERO and RLBench and demonstrating real-world long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, endowing policies with strong capabilities for modeling temporal and physical dynamics. Existing WAMs, encompassing both video-first action prediction and joint video-action modeling, directly transfer global physical representations from world models to action generation. However, global scene representations may underemphasize local robot-object interactions, creating a mismatch between representations optimized for world evolution and those required for manipulation. To bridge this gap, we propose LaST0.5, a novel WAM that introduces an interaction-centric physical representation between world modeling and action generation. Specifically, LaST0.5 learns a compact interaction-centric latent space under the supervision of visual interaction cues between the robot and the environment. This reasoning space is instantiated as a latent expert that bridges the world expert and the action expert within a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Furthermore, LaST0.5 performs adaptive world-to-action transfer by jointly predicting future representations and progress values, using progress consistency to adjust action execution and trigger future resampling. Finally, we pretrain LaST0.5 on a large-scale robotic data corpus comprising over 14k hours of data, establishing interaction-centric physical reasoning as a scalable and effective paradigm. LaST0.5 achieves 99.5% on LIBERO, surpasses the previous state of the art on ten evaluated RLBench tasks, and demonstrates robust long-horizon execution and precise dexterous manipulation in real-world experiments.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）近年来已成为机器人操作领域一种颇具前景的范式，为策略赋予了建模时间与物理动力学的强大能力。现有WAMs涵盖视频优先动作预测与视频-动作联合建模两类方法，均将世界模型中的全局物理表征直接迁移至动作生成。然而，全局场景表征可能弱化对局部机器人-物体交互的强调，从而导致面向世界演化的表征与面向操作所需的表征之间出现失配。为弥合这一差距，我们提出LaST0.5——一种新颖的WAM，在世界建模与动作生成之间引入了以交互为中心的物理表征。具体而言，LaST0.5在机器人与环境之间视觉交互线索的监督下，学习一个紧凑的以交互为中心的潜在空间。该推理空间被实例化为一个潜在专家，在混合变换器（Mixture-of-Transformers）架构中充当世界专家与动作专家之间的桥梁。此外，LaST0.5通过联合预测未来表征与进度值，实现从世界到动作的自适应迁移，并利用进度一致性来调整动作执行和触发未来重采样。最后，我们在包含超过14,000小时数据的大规模机器人数据语料库上对LaST0.5进行预训练，确立了以交互为中心的物理推理作为一种可扩展且有效的范式。LaST0.5在LIBERO基准上达到99.5%的准确率，在十个评估的RLBench任务上超越先前最先进方法，并在真实世界实验中展现出稳健的长时程执行能力和精细的灵巧操作能力。

Authors: Xuheng Zhang, Yiming Zhang, Jialin Gao, Hao Chen, Jiaming Liu, Ji Li, Runzhong Huang, Yinxi Wang, Chenyang Gu, Zihan Yang, Yaowei Liu, Zhonghao Yan, Ziyu Guo, Renrui Zhang, Peng Jia, Pheng-Ann Heng, Shanghang Zhang

RiSE-Drive: Risk-Sensitive Long-Horizon Candidate Evaluation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

risk-sensitive candidate evaluation long-horizon rollout end-to-end autonomous driving tail-risk-aware

简要说明：RiSE-Drive提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的风险敏感分布性候选评估框架，通过候选条件潜未来展开和尾部风险感知排序来提升长期鲁棒性，在NAVSIM和HUGSIM基准上达到最先进性能。

TLDR: RiSE-Drive introduces a risk-sensitive, distributional candidate evaluation framework for end-to-end autonomous driving, using candidate-conditioned latent future rollout and tail-risk-aware ranking to improve long-horizon robustness. It achieves state-of-the-art results on NAVSIM and HUGSIM benchmarks.

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving systems increasingly rely on generating multiple trajectory candidates and selecting one for execution. In this setting, a central challenge is no longer only candidate generation, but how to evaluate candidates according to their long-horizon consequences under uncertainty. Existing methods still mainly use deterministic point scores, heuristic subscores, or single-outcome evaluations, which makes it difficult to capture delayed failures, tail risk, and ranking instability under plausible future perturbations. We present RiSE-Drive, a framework for risk-sensitive long-horizon candidate evaluation in end-to-end autonomous driving. RiSE-Drive first performs candidate-conditioned latent future rollout, then estimates long-horizon outcome distributions instead of single scalar scores, and finally ranks candidates using a tail-risk-aware and perturbation-robust decision criterion. This reformulates candidate scoring from deterministic oracle-style evaluation into distributional outcome assessment with explicit risk control. As a result, the evaluator is encouraged to prefer candidates that are not only strong under nominal conditions, but also reliable under long-horizon rollout and safety-critical deviations. Experiments on the NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 benchmarks, as well as the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark, show that RiSE-Drive achieves state-of-the-art performance and significantly improves the robustness of candidate selection.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶系统日益依赖于生成多个轨迹候选并从中选择一个来执行。在此设定下，核心挑战不再仅仅是如何生成候选，而是如何在不确定性条件下根据候选的长期后果对其进行评估。现有方法仍主要依赖确定性点值评分、启发式子分数或单一结果评估，这使得难以捕捉延迟失效、尾部风险以及在未来合理扰动下的排序不稳定性。我们提出RiSE-Drive，一个用于端到端自动驾驶中风险敏感型长期候选评估的框架。RiSE-Drive首先执行候选条件化的潜在未来展开，然后估计长期结果分布而非单一标量分数，最后使用具有尾部风险感知和扰动鲁棒性的决策准则对候选进行排序。这将候选评分从确定性的“神谕式”评估重构为具有显式风险控制的分布性结果评估。由此，评估器被引导去偏好那些不仅在标称条件下表现强劲，而且在长期展开和安全关键偏差下同样可靠的候选。在NAVSIM-v1和NAVSIM-v2基准以及闭环HUGSIM基准上的实验表明，RiSE-Drive达到了最先进的性能，并显著提升了候选选择的鲁棒性。

Authors: Yu Zhao, Hongyi Duan, Ming Yin, Hongyuan Zhang, Fan Yang, Hongzhi Wang, Xiubo Liang

World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation Manipulation

In-Context Learning World Models Robot Manipulation Sim-to-Real Transfer Task Memory

简要说明：本文提出了世界上下文学习（WICL）范式，通过让冻结模型在模拟器中排练任务并将反馈写入上下文，仅凭单个演示即可学习操作任务，无需梯度更新即可获得高成功率，并能迁移到真实机器人。

TLDR: This paper introduces World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm where a frozen model learns manipulation tasks from a single demonstration by rehearsing in a simulator and writing feedback into its context, achieving high success rates without gradient updates and transferring to real robots.

Abstract: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. In-context learning (ICL) avoids this coupling but has not matched trained policies, because a demonstration recorded in another scene carries no feedback from the world the robot currently faces. We observe that what an agent learns in context is semantic, recording task steps and object roles rather than visual appearance, so experience gathered in one world transfers to another. Based on this insight, we propose World In-Context Learning (WICL), a paradigm in which a frozen model starts from a demonstration, rehearses the task in a world such as a simulator, and writes the feedback into its context rather than its weights. We build RoboScript, a modular infrastructure that implements WICL for agentic manipulation. From a single demonstration, RoboScript learns each task through rehearsal in simulation, freezes the learned knowledge as a Task Memory, and deploys the frozen memory on new scenes with data isolation that ensures every deployment input is available on a real robot. On all 50 tasks of RoboTwin 2.0, RoboScript reaches 83.4% mean success across clean and randomized settings with one demonstration per task and no gradient updates, exceeding the strongest trained action policy by over 20 points. The method generalizes across visual distributions, improves through reflection, scales with the foundation model, and transfers to a physical dual-arm robot through cross-embodiment memory adaptation. With a world in the loop, a robot can learn a manipulation task in its context as well as it learns one in its weights. All code is available at https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript

摘要（中文）：摘要： 经过训练的动作策略将操作技能写入网络权重，使所学内容与学习时所处的数据分布紧密耦合。上下文学习（ICL）避免了这种耦合，但尚未达到训练策略的水平，因为在其他场景中记录的演示无法从机器人当前面对的世界获得反馈。我们观察到，智能体在上下文中学习到的是语义层面的内容，记录的是任务步骤和物体角色而非视觉外观，因此在一个世界中积累的经验可以迁移到另一个世界。基于这一洞察，我们提出世界上下文学习（WICL），该范式下冻结模型从演示开始，在世界（如模拟器）中进行任务排练，并将反馈写入上下文而非权重。我们构建了RoboScript，一个模块化基础设施，为智能体操作任务实现WICL。仅从单一演示出发，RoboScript通过模拟排练学习每个任务，将学到的知识冻结为任务记忆（Task Memory），并以数据隔离的方式将冻结的记忆部署到新场景，确保每次部署输入均可在真实机器人上获取。在RoboTwin 2.0的全部50个任务上，RoboScript在干净场景和随机化场景中，每个任务仅需一个演示且无梯度更新的条件下，平均成功率达到了83.4%，超过最强训练动作策略20个百分点以上。该方法可跨视觉分布泛化，通过反思能力提升性能，随基础模型扩展，并通过跨具身记忆适配迁移至物理双臂机器人。有了世界在环路中，机器人在上下文中学习操作任务的能力可媲美其在权重中学习的能力。所有代码公开于https://github.com/ArcheOne-AI/RoboScript

Authors: Heng Fang, Zehui Guo, Yuehan Zhang, Mingyang Du, Dingkang Liang, Xiang Bai

SWAM: Scaling World Action Models with Cross-Modal Alignment VLA

world action models cross-modal alignment vision-language-action robotic manipulation sim-to-real

简要说明：本文系统研究了世界动作模型（WAM）的数据和监督策略，表明混合自我中心视频和UMI演示可提高控制泛化能力，并表明动作监督若处理不当会损害语言-视频对齐。所得模型在仿真和真实任务中取得高成功率，展现了更好的泛化性。

TLDR: This paper systematically studies data and supervision strategies for world action models (WAMs), showing that mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization and that action supervision can impair language-video alignment if not properly handled. The resulting model achieves high success rates in simulation and real-world tasks, demonstrating better generalization.

Abstract: World action models jointly predict video and actions conditioned on language. Existing studies focus primarily on architectures and training mechanisms, typically treating language-video alignment acquired through video pretraining as an established foundation. However, introducing action learning may impair this alignment. Principled guidance on data and supervision design for maintaining language-video alignment during action learning remains limited. To investigate this, we curate a pool of approximately 47,000 hours of general videos, egocentric videos, UMI demonstrations, and robot demonstrations. Building on this, we systematically study how language-video supervision, language-video-action supervision, and the joint use of these two forms affect WAM performance. In particular, we examine how language annotation quality affects pretrained language-video capabilities, and how action supervision from UMI and robot demonstrations extends these capabilities to language-video-action modeling. To better scale the model, we further conduct detailed studies on joint training recipe and model architecture. Under a fixed training budget, mixing egocentric videos and UMI demonstrations improves control generalization. Model architecture affects how effectively these experiences are used, while scaling pretraining under the selected configuration brings further gains. The resulting recipe, post-trained on RoboTwin Clean demonstrations only, achieves success rates of 88.10% and 61.56% under Easy (Clean-to-Clean) and Hard (Clean-to-Random) conditions, respectively. Our model achieves 40.00% SR across three real-world tasks, compared with 23.33% for the strongest baseline, indicating better generalization under unseen conditions. We release the curated data, training code, and model weights.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型基于语言条件联合预测视频与动作。现有研究主要聚焦于架构和训练机制，通常将视频预训练所获得的语言-视频对齐视为既定基础。然而，引入动作学习可能削弱这种对齐。在动作学习过程中，关于数据与监督设计以维持语言-视频对齐的原则性指导仍然有限。为探究这一问题，我们构建了约47,000小时的通用视频、第一人称视频、UMI演示和机器人演示数据池。在此基础上，我们系统研究了语言-视频监督、语言-视频-动作监督以及这两种形式的联合使用对世界动作模型性能的影响。具体而言，我们考察了语言标注质量如何影响预训练的语言-视频能力，以及来自UMI和机器人演示的动作监督如何将这些能力扩展至语言-视频-动作建模。为更好地扩展模型规模，我们进一步对联合训练策略和模型架构进行了详细研究。在固定训练预算下，混合第一人称视频和UMI演示可提升控制泛化能力。模型架构影响这些经验被有效利用的程度，而在所选配置下扩展预训练规模可带来进一步增益。所得到的训练方案仅使用RoboTwin Clean演示进行后训练，在Easy（Clean-to-Clean）和Hard（Clean-to-Random）条件下分别达到88.10%和61.56%的成功率。我们的模型在三个真实世界任务中实现了40.00%的成功率，而最强基线仅为23.33%，表明在未见条件下具有更好的泛化能力。我们公开了整理的数据、训练代码和模型权重。

Authors: Yu Zhou, Xinyuan Xia, Xuankun Yang, Yinghao Yang, Wendi Chen, Bowen Liu, Jianhan Ma, Weicheng Duan, Jun Lv, Cewu Lu, Yanwei Li

SIGMO: Sigmoid Gated Interaction-Aware Motion Planning AutonomousDriving

interaction-aware motion planning sigmoid gating receding-horizon planning autonomous driving trajectory prediction

简要说明：SIGMO 提出了一种用于自动驾驶汽车的 sigmoid 门控交互感知运动规划器，利用多项式 sigmoid 函数估计让行分数，并将其集成到滚动时域规划器中，实现轻量级、主动且防御性的导航。

TLDR: SIGMO introduces a sigmoid-gated interaction-aware motion planner for autonomous vehicles, using polynomial sigmoid functions to estimate yield scores and integrating them into a receding-horizon planner for lightweight, proactive yet defensive navigation in cluttered environments.

Abstract: Despite the widespread adoption of autonomous vehicle technologies, reliable navigation within cluttered environments remains arduous due to the necessity of interaction-aware strategies; example scenarios include: narrow passages with multiple agents, lane changing in dense traffic, and crossing unsignalized intersections. These scenarios often require highly proactive strategies, simultaneously demanding interpretability and quick adaptability, which challenge end-to-end and data-driven methods. An effective strategy requires: scalability to multiple agents, adaptability to changes in other agents' behavior, and harmony with surrounding traffic without freezing or becoming overly conservative. To meet these requirements, we present SIGMO, a sigmoid-gated interaction-aware motion planner, with two main contributions. First, we formulate polynomial sigmoid functions that analytically estimate yield scores of surrounding agents using physics-grounded interaction features that capture driving intuitions. Second, we integrate the polynomial sigmoid functions into a receding-horizon planner, which facilitates interaction-aware planning with arbitrary trajectory predictions. We validate SIGMO in interaction-intensive simulations and hardware experiments. The results show that SIGMO balances proactive and defensive behavior while remaining computationally lightweight, serving as a strong baseline in a mobility stack. The simulation and hardware experiment videos are available here: https://sites.google.com/view/sigmoid-polygate.

摘要（中文）：尽管自动驾驶技术已被广泛采用，但在杂乱环境中实现可靠导航仍具挑战性，原因在于需要具备交互感知策略；典型场景包括：包含多个智能体的狭窄通道、密集交通中的变道，以及无信号交叉口的穿越。这些场景往往要求高度主动的策略，同时需要可解释性和快速适应性，这对端到端及数据驱动的方法构成了挑战。一种有效的策略需具备：对多个智能体的可扩展性，对其他智能体行为变化的适应性，以及与周围交通的协调性——既不冻结停滞，也不过保守。为满足这些需求，我们提出了SIGMO——一种基于S型门控的交互感知运动规划器，其包含两项主要贡献。首先，我们构建了多项式S型函数，利用基于物理的交互特征来解析估计周围智能体的让行得分，从而捕捉驾驶直觉。其次，我们将该多项式S型函数集成到滚动时域规划器中，以支持任意轨迹预测下的交互感知规划。我们在交互密集的仿真及硬件实验中验证了SIGMO的性能。结果表明，SIGMO在主动性与防御性行为之间取得了平衡，同时保持了计算轻量化，可作为移动性软件栈中的强基线。仿真及硬件实验视频见：https://sites.google.com/view/sigmoid-polygate。

Authors: Avinash Singh, Manish Saroya, Fatemeh Cheraghi Pouria, Faizan Tariq, Jovin D'sa, David Isele, Yosuke Sakamoto, Sangjae Bae

From Video Frames to Robot Meta-Frames: A Unified Latent Interface for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models video diffusion models latent interface frequency-domain packing robot manipulation

简要说明：MetaWAM 提出一种统一的元帧接口，将机器人信号折叠到预训练视频扩散模型潜空间的频域通道带中，使单一模型能够执行策略、世界模型和价值预测，在机器人操作任务中提高了效率和成功率。

TLDR: MetaWAM introduces a unified meta-frame interface that folds robot signals into frequency-domain channel bands within a pretrained video diffusion model's latent space, enabling a single model to perform policy, world-model, and value prediction for robot manipulation with improved efficiency and success rates.

Abstract: Pretrained video diffusion models (VDMs) offer a powerful foundation for World Action Models (WAMs), which jointly predict robot actions and future observations. Building such models requires injecting low-dimensional robot signals (e.g. proprioception, actions, and values) into a latent space shaped by natural videos, and a key design choice is the interface through which these signals enter: existing schemes treat it as a formatting detail, spending a separate latent frame on each signal or bolting on dedicated encoders and decoders. We argue that signal injection is instead a distribution-alignment problem: how well a representation matches the prior of the pretrained VDMs during denoising. Using the relative reconstruction error of a frozen VDM denoiser as a probe, we find that conventional spatial encodings sit far off this prior, whereas frequency-domain packing yields latents that the denoiser corrects far less. Motivated by this diagnostic result, we propose MetaWAM, which folds all robot signals into a single unified meta-frame: each signal is assigned to a disjoint frequency-domain channel band and lifted to the spatial latent by an inverse DCT, yielding a decodable interface aligned with the pretrained VDM prior without any added module or architectural change. A fixed band layout together with slot-aware routing lets the same meta-frame support policy, world-model, and value prediction over a shared set of robot variables. On RoboCasa, MetaWAM reaches 68.9% success while collapsing the per-signal frames into one and cutting inference latency by 39%, and attains 85.0% success on three real-world Franka tasks. Code and models are available at https://github.com/showlab/MetaWAM

摘要（中文）：预训练视频扩散模型（VDMs）为世界动作模型（WAMs）提供了强大的基础，后者能够联合预测机器人动作和未来观测。构建此类模型需要将低维机器人信号（如本体感觉、动作和值）注入到由自然视频塑造的潜空间中，而关键的设计选择在于这些信号进入的接口方式：现有方案将其视为格式化细节，为每个信号分配单独的潜帧，或附加专用的编码器和解码器。我们认为信号注入本质上是一个分布对齐问题：即在去噪过程中，表示与预训练VDMs先验的匹配程度。以冻结的VDM去噪器的相对重构误差作为探针，我们发现传统的空间编码与这一先验相距甚远，而频域打包产生的潜向量则被去噪器修正的程度要小得多。基于这一诊断结果，我们提出了MetaWAM，它将所有机器人信号折叠到一个统一的元帧中：每个信号被分配到不相交的频域通道带，并通过逆离散余弦变换（inverse DCT）提升到空间潜空间，从而形成一个与预训练VDM先验对齐的可解码接口，无需增加任何模块或改变架构。固定的频带布局结合槽感知路由，使得同一元帧能够在共享的机器人变量集合上支持策略、世界模型和值预测。在RoboCasa上，MetaWAM达到了68.9%的成功率，同时将每个信号的帧压缩为一帧并将推理延迟降低了39%，在三个真实世界Franka任务上则达到了85.0%的成功率。代码和模型可在 https://github.com/showlab/MetaWAM 获取。

Authors: Guoqiang Liang, Yiqi Lin, Yanzhe Chen, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Mike Zheng Shou

ForeseeDrive: Future-Token Conditioning for Anticipatory Generative Driving AutonomousDriving

generative driving planner future-token conditioning trajectory generation TTC margin candidate-preservation loss

简要说明：ForeseeDrive 提出了一种未来令牌条件化机制，在候选采样前通过从演员运动、占用率、路线交互和 TTC 裕度派生的查询索引令牌来塑造生成的驾驶轨迹。在 NAVSIM、nuScenes 和 Bench2Drive 上展示了强劲的基准结果，并通过机制测试确认了条件生成接口的有效性。

TLDR: ForeseeDrive introduces a future-token conditioning mechanism that shapes generated driving trajectories before candidate sampling, using query-indexed tokens from actor motion, occupancy, route interactions, and TTC margins. It demonstrates strong benchmark results on NAVSIM, nuScenes, and Bench2Drive, with mechanism tests confirming the effectiveness of the conditional generation interface.

Abstract: Generative driving planners can represent diverse ego futures, but a downstream scorer can choose only among sampled candidates; it cannot recover an absent maneuver. We present ForeseeDrive, which turns future scene evolution into a deployable interface for shaping candidate generation. Rather than reconstructing dense future states or scoring a fixed menu, ForeseeDrive derives query-indexed tokens from logged actor motion, occupancy evolution, route interactions, and TTC margins, and predicts the same token space from present context at deployment. The tokens condition trajectory geometry before candidates materialize. A zero-token-gated residual path and candidate-preservation loss limit unnecessary drift, while a TTC-margin guard targets brittle safe-to-unsafe boundary crossings. Under their respective benchmark protocols, ForeseeDrive reaches 89.2 PDMS on NAVSIM navtest, 0.41\,m average L2 and 0.05\% collision rate on nuScenes validation, and a 76.50 driving score on Bench2Drive. Controlled DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM diagnostics show an exact zero-token no-op, a small aligned-over-shuffled selected-PDM advantage under preservation, mixed oracle-best quality, and localized TTC-boundary failures. Together, the benchmark results and bounded mechanism tests support future-conditioned generation as a practical interface for anticipation. Code is included in the supplementary materials.

摘要（中文）：生成式驾驶规划器能够表征多样的自车未来轨迹，但下游评分器只能从采样候选中进行选择，无法恢复未出现的驾驶行为。我们提出ForeseeDrive，将未来场景演化转化为一种可部署的接口，用于塑造候选轨迹的生成。ForeseeDrive并非重建稠密的未来状态，也非对固定候选集进行评分，而是从记录的参与者运动、占用演化、路线交互和碰撞时间（TTC）裕度中提取查询索引化的令牌，并在部署时从当前上下文预测相同的令牌空间。这些令牌在候选轨迹具体化之前对轨迹几何进行条件约束。零令牌门控残差路径和候选保留损失限制了不必要的漂移，而TTC裕度防护机制则针对脆弱的“安全到不安全”边界穿越进行干预。在各自对应的基准协议下，ForeseeDrive在NAVSIM navtest上达到89.2的PDMS，在nuScenes验证集上实现0.41米的平均L2误差和0.05%的碰撞率，并在Bench2Drive上取得76.50的驾驶评分。受控的DiffusionDrive/NAVSIM诊断实验表明：精确的零令牌无操作行为、保留机制下对齐优于打乱排列的PDM选优优势、混合的oracle最优质量，以及局部化的TTC边界失效。综合基准结果与受限机制测试，研究支持将未来条件化生成作为预测性驾驶规划的一种实用接口。代码包含在补充材料中。

Authors: Shaokai Wu, Xunchu Zhou, Pinzhi Wang, Bo Dong, Yuting Hu, Yanbiao Ji, Qiuchang Li, Xiao Cui, Qi Kong, Hongtao Lu, Yue Ding

From Prediction to Action: Learning Physical Context for Deformable Linear Object Manipulation Manipulation

Deformable Linear Objects manipulation policy physical context sim-to-real decision utility

简要说明：本文研究了可变形线性物体操作中物理上下文表示的预测效用与决策效用之间的区别，提出了一种几何基础策略主干，表明学习到的交互历史表示在控制方面优于估计的物理参数，尽管其预测能力较弱。

TLDR: This paper investigates the distinction between predictive and decision utility of physical context representations in deformable linear object manipulation, introducing a geometry-grounded policy backbone that shows learned interaction-history representations outperform estimated physical parameters for control despite being less predictive.

Abstract: A representation that accurately predicts a deformable object's response is not necessarily the one most useful for choosing manipulation actions. We study this distinction between predictive utility and decision utility in planar single-grasp shape control of Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs). As a common decision backbone, we introduce Geometry-Pointer-Flow (GPF), a geometry-grounded policy that separates grasp-location selection from grasp-conditioned motion generation. Its geometry-only variant reduces one-step executed shape error by 32.8% relative to a DLO-specific diffusion policy, while using 18.7 times fewer parameters and achieving approximately 193 times faster inference. On this backbone, we compare physical context represented by ground-truth parameters, estimated parameters, and learned interaction-history representations, for both forward prediction and executed control. For prediction, ground-truth physical parameters reduce next-shape error by 15.8% over geometry alone, and estimated parameters are slightly more predictive than interaction history. This ordering does not carry over to control: estimated parameters provide no detectable one-step control gain, whereas history-conditioned GPF reduces executed error by 9.9% relative to geometry-only GPF across 470 paired simulation trials. In closed loop, interaction history improves strict-threshold attainment in simulation and yields the strongest zero-shot performance on hardware. All policies are trained exclusively in simulation and transferred to the physical robot without real-world training or fine-tuning. These results show that physical context should be evaluated by the decisions it supports rather than by predictive accuracy alone. Code will be released upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：摘要：能够精确预测可变形物体响应的表征，未必是选择操作动作时最有用的表征。本文研究了平面单抓取形状控制中可变形线性物体（DLOs）的预测效用与决策效用之间的区别。作为共同的决策主干，我们提出了几何指针流（GPF）——一种基于几何学的策略，将抓取位置选择与抓取条件下的运动生成相分离。其纯几何变体相对于专用DLO扩散策略，单步执行形状误差降低了32.8%，同时参数量减少了18.7倍，推理速度提升约193倍。在此主干上，我们比较了由真实参数、估计参数和学习到的交互历史表征所表示的物理上下文，分别用于前向预测和执行控制。在预测方面，真实物理参数相比纯几何方法将下一步形状误差降低了15.8%，而估计参数的预测性能略优于交互历史表征。然而，这一排序在控制任务中并不成立：估计参数未带来可检测的单步控制增益，而在470次配对仿真试验中，基于历史条件的GPF相比纯几何GPF将执行误差降低了9.9%。在闭环控制中，交互历史表征在仿真中提升了严格阈值达成率，并在硬件上展现出最强的零样本迁移性能。所有策略均仅在仿真中训练，并直接迁移至物理机器人，未进行真实世界训练或微调。上述结果表明，物理上下文的评估应基于其所支持的决策能力，而非仅依据预测精度。代码将在论文被接收后发布。

Authors: Chengxiao Dong, Alessio Caporali, Hongyu Lan, Gianluca Palli

Elastic-WAM: Adaptive Spatiotemporal Imagination for Efficient Robot Control WorldModel

World-Action Models adaptive computation denoising robot control efficiency

简要说明：Elastic-WAM 提出了一种自适应时空细化机制，用于世界动作模型，在去噪时间和空间区域上分配计算，以提高机器人控制的效率和性能。

TLDR: Elastic-WAM introduces an adaptive spatiotemporal refinement mechanism for World-Action Models, allocating computation across denoising time and spatial regions to improve robot control efficiency and performance.

Abstract: World-Action Models improve robot control by predicting future visual dynamics, but iterative video denoising incurs substantial inference overhead. Recent approaches reduce this cost through partial future denoising, yet typically rely on fixed refinement budgets. Our empirical observations reveal that preferred refinement depths vary across tasks and states, while different future regions exhibit varying relevance to action generation. Motivated by these findings, we propose Elastic-WAM, which adaptively allocates world refinement computation across temporal denoising time and spatial future space. A unified spatiotemporal refinement demand field governs when to stop world refinement, how far to advance each denoising step, and which regions to refresh. We parameterize this field with a shared temporal basis and spatial amplitudes, and learn it through a three-stage action-grounded supervised procedure. At inference, the learned field guides recurrent sparse world refinement to improve task success while reducing inference overhead. Evaluations across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world long-horizon manipulation demonstrate state-of-the-art control performance with reduced inference latency.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过预测未来视觉动态来提升机器人控制性能，但迭代式视频去噪过程带来了显著的推理开销。近期研究通过部分未来去噪来降低这一成本，然而这些方法通常依赖固定的细化预算。我们的实验观察表明，最优细化深度因任务和状态而异，同时不同未来区域对动作生成的关联程度也各不相同。基于这些发现，我们提出弹性世界模型（Elastic-WAM），该模型在时间去噪步数和空间未来区域两个维度上自适应分配世界细化计算资源。一个统一的时空细化需求场用于决定何时停止世界细化、每个去噪步应推进多远，以及哪些区域需要刷新。我们以共享的时间基函数和空间幅度系数对该场进行参数化，并通过一个三阶段、基于动作监督的训练流程进行学习。在推理阶段，学习得到的需求场引导循环稀疏世界细化过程，从而在提升任务成功率的同时降低推理开销。在多种仿真基准和真实世界长时程操作任务上的评估结果表明，该方法在降低推理延迟的同时实现了最先进的操控性能。

Authors: Haitian Li, Tianfu Li, Xuxi Zhao, Zizheng Liu, Yangcheng Yu, Yiwen Hou, Zeyu Xiao, Mutian Xu, Ziqian Yang, Haonan Chen, Lin Shao

Koopman Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Locomotion

Koopman operator model-based reinforcement learning quadruped locomotion policy gradient sample efficiency

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于Koopman算子的模型强化学习方法，用于非线性机器人控制，通过线性动力学近似和critic估计长期成本，并在仿真和真实四足机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Koopman operator-based model-based reinforcement learning method for nonlinear robotic control, using a linear dynamics approximation and a critic to estimate long-term costs, demonstrated in simulations and on a real quadruped robot.

Abstract: We propose a Koopman model-based reinforcement learning (K-MBRL) algorithm for controlling nonlinear robotic systems with unknown dynamics. The K-MBRL learns a control policy by minimizing an approximate policy objective that combines the analytical immediate cost with an estimate of the future cost evaluated at the one-step predicted state. To this end, we develop a stochastic Koopman operator-based learning method to approximate the unknown nonlinear dynamics in a linear representation, while a critic function estimates the remaining future cost. This formulation offers two key advantages. First, the linear Koopman dynamics simplify the model-dependent policy gradient computation to a constant matrix product, enabling computationally efficient policy improvement. Second, one-step model propagation mitigates the accumulation of prediction errors associated with long-horizon rollouts while retaining long-term cost information through the critic. The learned policy enables real-time control through feedforward evaluation without online optimization. We establish policy learning convergence guarantees under standard stochastic approximation assumptions. Simulations on HalfCheetah and quadruped four-legged locomotion tasks demonstrate strong sample efficiency and improved performance compared with classical model-free and model-based reinforcement learning baselines. A pendulum swing-up task is used to assess policy gradient approximation accuracy and conduct ablation studies on the learning mechanism and key hyperparameters. The proposed K-MBRL is further validated on a physical quadruped robot performing a challenging sequence of maneuvers: rising to an upright posture supported by two rounded rear feet, maintaining balance during bipedal walking, and safely returning to the ground, as shown in Fig.1.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种基于Koopman模型的强化学习（K-MBRL）算法，用于控制动力学未知的非线性机器人系统。K-MBRL通过最小化一个近似策略目标来学习控制策略，该目标将解析即时成本与基于一步预测状态评估的未来成本估计相结合。为此，我们开发了一种基于随机Koopman算子的学习方法，以线性表示形式逼近未知的非线性动力学，同时利用评论者函数估计剩余的未来成本。该公式具有两个关键优势。首先，线性Koopman动力学将依赖于模型的策略梯度计算简化为常数矩阵乘积，从而实现了计算高效的策略改进。其次，一步模型传播减轻了与长视界轨迹展开相关的预测误差累积，同时通过评论者保留了长期成本信息。学习到的策略通过前馈评估实现实时控制，无需在线优化。我们在标准随机逼近假设下建立了策略学习收敛性保证。在HalfCheetah和四足机器人行走任务上的仿真表明，与经典的无模型和基于模型的强化学习基线相比，该算法具有强大的样本效率和改进的性能。利用摆起摆任务评估策略梯度逼近精度，并对学习机制和关键超参数进行消融研究。所提出的K-MBRL进一步在物理四足机器人上进行了验证，该机器人执行了一系列具有挑战性的动作：从两轮后脚支撑的直立姿态起身，在双足行走过程中保持平衡，并安全返回地面，如图1所示。

Authors: Wenjian Hao, Paulo C. Heredia, Shaoshuai Mou

LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics Other

agentic robotics safety benchmark foundation models vision-language-action robot control

简要说明：该论文提出了 RoboRisk，一个面向代理式机器人的综合安全基准，以及 LEASH，一种利用基础模型的任务/动作/提交门控安全机制，在保持任务性能的同时有效降低危害。

TLDR: This paper introduces RoboRisk, a comprehensive safety benchmark for agentic robotics, and LEASH, a safety harness with task/action/commit gates using foundation models to reduce harm while preserving task performance.

Abstract: Foundation models such as GPT and Claude have shown strong capabilities in spatial understanding and embodied intelligence. These advances make agentic robotics a promising path toward artificial general intelligence in robotics. However, we find that using foundation models to control robots poses serious safety risks, and comprehensive safety evaluation is still lacking. We introduce RoboRisk, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating safety in agentic robotics. Its 92 simulated tasks and 13 physical-robot tasks fall into five categories: Task-level Refusal (T), Plan Repair (P), Execution-time Hazard (E), Injection (I), and Sequential Memory (S). Prior benchmarks cover at most two of these categories, and several evaluate only text outputs. In contrast, RoboRisk covers all five and executes every task in closed loop. We evaluate six state-of-the-art foundation models on RoboRisk: GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Claude Opus 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, and Grok 4.7. These models generally show high harm rates. We also evaluate two robot-specific APIs: the Dream API and PokeBot's RoboAPI. We further propose the Lease-Enforced Agentic Safety Harness (LEASH), which offers essential safety infrastructure for agentic robotics and can be integrated into nearly any agentic architecture. LEASH leverages a decision model (Jev or OpenAI's Decisions API) to implement task, action, and commit gates, which review the task, each action, and each irreversible operation in their visual context. The planner and all three gates share a common safety policy. Experiments on RoboRisk in simulation and on physical robots show that LEASH effectively reduces harm across all six foundation models. It largely preserves their task completion performance and adds little time and token overhead.

摘要（中文）：基础模型（如GPT和Claude）在空间理解和具身智能方面展现出了强大的能力。这些进展使得智能体机器人成为通往机器人领域通用人工智能的一条有前景的路径。然而，我们发现使用基础模型控制机器人存在严重的安全风险，且目前仍缺乏全面的安全评估。我们引入了RoboRisk，一个用于评估智能体机器人安全性的综合基准。其92个模拟任务和13个物理机器人任务分为五类：任务级拒绝（T）、计划修复（P）、执行时危险（E）、注入（I）和序列记忆（S）。以往的基准最多覆盖其中两类，且若干基准仅评估文本输出。相比之下，RoboRisk覆盖了全部五类，并在闭环中执行每一个任务。我们在RoboRisk上评估了六个最先进的基础模型：GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Luna、Claude Opus 5.5、Gemini 4 Argon和Grok 4.7。这些模型普遍表现出较高的危害率。我们还评估了两个机器人专用API：Dream API和PokeBot的RoboAPI。我们进一步提出了租赁强制智能体安全防护装置（LEASH），为智能体机器人提供基本的安全基础设施，并可集成到几乎任何智能体架构中。LEASH利用决策模型（Jev或OpenAI的Decisions API）实现任务门、动作门和提交门，在其视觉上下文中审查任务、每个动作以及每个不可逆操作。规划器和三个门共享统一的安全策略。在RoboRisk上的模拟和物理机器人实验表明，LEASH有效降低了全部六个基础模型的危害率，同时基本保留了其任务完成性能，且增加的时间和令牌开销很小。

Authors: Qinfeng Zhu, Weiguang Zhao, Ke Sun, Xihao Guo, Yunxi Jiang, Rui Zhang, Lei Fan, Kaizhu Huang

DexSeed: Expanding Human Hand-Object Interactions into Robot Demonstrations for Dexterous Policy Learning Manipulation

dexterous manipulation robot demonstrations vision-language-action (VLA) retargeting physics simulation

简要说明：DexSeed通过扩展人手-物体交互序列、保持抓取并在物理仿真中结合手臂跟踪动力学和强化学习控制，低成本生成可用于灵巧VLA训练的多样化机器人演示；仅用这些合成数据微调的VLA能在仿真和真实世界中执行语言指定的抓取。

TLDR: DexSeed generates diverse, physically executable robot demonstrations for dexterous VLA learning by expanding human hand-object interaction sequences, preserving grasps, and using RL control with arm-tracking in simulation; fine-tuning a VLA on this data enables language-specified grasps in sim and real world.

Abstract: We study how to generate diverse, physically executable robot demonstrations for dexterous vision-language-action (VLA) learning. Existing demonstration-generation methods typically rely on costly teleoperated examples. Meanwhile, human hand--object datasets provide a reusable source, but existing transfer methods mainly reproduce given interactions. Turning these interactions into VLA training data further requires coverage of different objects and manipulation locations, together with executable arm and finger actions, and visual observations. To achieve this, we present DexSeed, a framework for low-cost generation of dexterous robot data from human hand--object interactions. Our key idea is to expand human sequences while preserving their grasps and realizing the resulting motions under arm-tracking dynamics in physics simulation. Specifically, we organize source sequences by grasp mode with shared language descriptions. InteractionMesh-based retargeting and arm trajectory augmentation adapt these sequences to the robot hand, different object geometries, and pick-and-place locations while preserving local hand--object relationships. An RL finger-control policy produces executable rollouts, while the arm tracks precomputed trajectories. Rendered observations and recorded actions from successful rollouts are paired with grasp descriptions to fine-tune a VLA. Experiments show improved contact fidelity in retargeting and more reliable whole-arm execution than the evaluated baselines. Simulation evaluation and real-world deployment further demonstrate that a VLA fine-tuned solely on the generated demonstrations can execute language-specified grasps. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/DexSeed/.

摘要（中文）：我们研究如何为灵巧的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）学习生成多样化、物理上可执行的机器人演示。现有的演示生成方法通常依赖于成本高昂的遥操作示例。与此同时，人类手-物体数据集提供了一种可复用的来源，但现有的迁移方法主要复现给定的交互。将这些交互转化为VLA训练数据，还需要覆盖不同的物体和操作位置，以及可执行的臂和手指动作以及视觉观察。为此，我们提出了DexSeed，一个从人类手-物体交互中低成本生成灵巧机器人数据的框架。我们的核心思想是扩展人类序列，同时保留其抓取方式，并在物理仿真中通过手臂跟踪动力学实现所得到的运动。具体而言，我们通过共享语言描述按抓取模式组织源序列。基于InteractionMesh的重定向和手臂轨迹增强使这些序列适应机器人手、不同物体几何形状以及抓取-放置位置，同时保持局部手-物体关系。一个强化学习手指控制策略生成可执行的展开轨迹，而手臂则跟踪预计算的轨迹。成功展开过程中的渲染观测和记录动作与抓取描述配对，用于微调VLA。实验表明，在重定向方面，接触保真度有所提高，并且相比评估的基线方法，整个手臂的执行更加可靠。仿真评估和真实世界部署进一步证明，仅基于生成的演示进行微调的VLA能够执行语言指定的抓取任务。项目页面：https://robbyant-research.github.io/DexSeed/。

Authors: Huaijin Pi, Zehong Shen, Yong Wang, Kechun Xu, Changpeng Wang, Dingkun Wei, Xueyang Wang, Wenjia Wang, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Taku Komura

ReACT: Reflection-Consistent Modulation and Cross-Load Consistency for Humanoid Velocity Tracking Under Asymmetric Loads HumanoidEmbodied

velocity tracking asymmetric loads reflection-consistent modulation cross-load consistency humanoid locomotion

简要说明：ReACT提出了一种结合反射一致扰动调制和跨负载一致性训练的方法，以改善非对称负载下人形机器人的速度跟踪，并通过仿真和真实世界导航实验验证。

TLDR: ReACT introduces a framework combining reflection-consistent disturbance modulation and cross-load consistency training to improve humanoid velocity tracking under asymmetric loads, validated through simulations and real-world navigation trials.

Abstract: In recent years, humanoid loco-manipulation has progressed to whole-body grasping, lifting, and transport. A basic requirement underlying these tasks is carrying the object to its destination, which depends on the locomotion controller accurately executing velocity commands from the navigation policy. However, carrying an object in one hand introduces a persistent asymmetric upper-body load that can degrade velocity tracking. Persistent tracking biases can accumulate into position and heading deviations, increasing the risk of collisions and navigation failure. To address this problem, we present ReACT, a framework for accurate velocity tracking under asymmetric upper-body loads. Reflection-consistent disturbance modulation uses the estimated wrench to modulate actor features for load compensation while preserving action correspondence under reflected observations. Cross-load tracking consistency training compares loaded and unloaded conditions under the same velocity commands to promote consistent velocity tracking across loading conditions. Simulation experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot show improved velocity tracking and reduced directional bias under varying asymmetric loads. Real-world experiments demonstrate collision-free goal reaching in all 40 tested navigation trials under unilateral hand loads with a fixed mapless navigation policy.

摘要（中文）：近年来，人形机器人全身操作技术已发展到能够执行全身抓取、举升和搬运任务。这些任务的一个基本前提是将物体运送至目的地，这依赖于运动控制器精确执行导航策略生成的速速指令。然而，单手搬运物体会引入持续的不对称上半身负载，可能削弱速度跟踪的准确性。持续存在的跟踪偏差会累积为位置和航向偏差，增加碰撞风险并可能导致导航失败。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ReACT框架，用于在不对称上半身负载下实现精确的速度跟踪。反射一致扰动调制利用估计的力/力矩信息调制actor特征以进行负载补偿，同时在反射观测下保持动作一致性。跨负载跟踪一致性训练在相同速度指令下比较加载与未加载条件，以促进不同负载条件下的速度跟踪一致性。在Unitree G1人形机器人上进行的仿真实验表明，在不同不对称负载下速度跟踪性能得到改善，方向偏差有所减少。真实世界实验验证了在固定无地图导航策略下单侧手部负载条件下，40次导航测试全部实现了无碰撞到达目标。

Authors: Xianghui Wang, Aoran Fu, Liyou Luo, Shanze Wang, Xiaoyu Shen, Dan Zhang, Wei Zhang

Game-Enhanced Embodied Learning with Event and Foresight Pretraining VLA

game pretraining InternVLA event prediction visual foresight LIBERO

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于游戏增强的预训练方法，结合事件预测和视觉预见，在游戏数据上训练InternVLA-A1.5，提升了LIBERO基准上的机器人操作成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a game-enhanced pretraining method for the InternVLA-A1.5 model, combining event prediction and visual foresight on gameplay data, which improves robot manipulation success rates on LIBERO benchmarks.

Abstract: Human gameplay supplies paired observations, actions, and visual consequences that can supplement robot-policy training. We study event-and-foresight pretraining for InternVLA-A1.5, combining recorded keyboard/mouse event prediction with history-conditioned visual supervision through a frozen video model. Coverage-preserving anchor selection constructs one-second targets, and an attention mask prevents teacher-forced future actions from entering foresight queries. The selected corpus contains 394 recordings across 20 games, with 223.36 hours of recorded timestamp span and 2,072,084 training anchors. After 12,400 game-pretraining updates, we compare the resulting initialization with the public base under the same suite-specific robot fine-tuning protocol. Across four LIBERO suites, aggregate success increases from 1,718/2,000 (85.90%) to 1,811/2,000 (90.55%), a gain of 4.65 percentage points. Suite gains are 9.2, 6.8, 0.2, and 2.4 points on Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long. The 40-task breakdown shows 24 improvements, 10 declines, and six ties. These results support the practical value of the complete game-pretraining stage in this evaluated setting, while revealing heterogeneous task outcomes. The comparison includes additional optimization and does not isolate the effects of game data, the two objectives, or training variability.

摘要（中文）：人类游戏过程提供了成对的观察、动作及视觉结果，可用于补充机器人策略训练。我们研究了InternVLA-A1.5中的事件与前瞻预训练方法，结合记录的键盘/鼠标事件预测与基于历史条件的视觉监督，并使用冻结视频模型实现视觉监督。通过覆盖保持的锚点选择构建一秒目标，并利用注意力掩码防止教师强制的未来动作进入前瞻查询。所选语料库包含来自20款游戏的394段录像，记录时间戳跨度达223.36小时，共生成2,072,084个训练锚点。在完成12,400次游戏预训练更新后，我们在相同的任务套件专用机器人微调协议下，将所得初始化与公开基线进行比较。在四个LIBERO任务套件中，整体成功率从1,718/2,000（85.90%）提升至1,811/2,000（90.55%），提高了4.65个百分点。在空间、物体、目标和长时程套件上的增益分别为9.2、6.8、0.2和2.4个百分点。在40个任务的分项统计中，24项有改进，10项有下降，6项持平。这些结果支持在该评估设置下完整游戏预训练阶段具有实际价值，同时也揭示了任务结果的异质性。该比较包含了额外的优化，并未单独隔离游戏数据、两个训练目标或训练变异的影响。

Authors: Lianlei Shan, Han Jin, Yaunchao Ma, Xinpeng Chen, Linhao Zhou, Xin Bin

WAM is capable in BEHAVIOR-1K: the 2nd-place solution to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge Manipulation

world action model mobile manipulation BEHAVIOR-1K LoRA adapters task-progress conditioning

简要说明：本文介绍了2026年BEHAVIOR挑战赛的亚军方案，基于Cosmos 3世界动作模型，通过丰富的视觉历史、任务进度条件化和LoRA适配器增强，在100项具身家庭移动操作任务中实现了41.2%的成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents the 2nd-place solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge, built on the Cosmos 3 world action model enhanced with visual history, task-progress conditioning, and LoRA adapters, achieving a 41.2% success rate in embodied household mobile manipulation tasks.

Abstract: This work presents the 2nd-place solution (Team IF1001) to the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge, which evaluates mobile manipulation across 100 household tasks. Our method is built on a powerful world action model (WAM), Cosmos 3. We improve Cosmos 3 by using richer visual history, task-progress conditioning, and task-group and skill-specific LoRA adapters. During inference, we apply a separate progress estimator to supply task-progress context, and use task- and progress-conditioned routing to select a task-group or skill-specific policy, complemented by action-candidate aggregation, rolling inpainting, and task-specific temporal and gripper control. To meet the minimum inference requirement of 1 FPS, we use neither recursive self-improvement (RSI) nor agentic harness methods and rely on no closed-source models; during official private-test evaluation, our system handled concurrent requests across 100 evaluation ports with limited hardware resources, sustaining an average end-to-end inference rate above 2 FPS per port. Our method achieves a mean Q-score of 0.613 and a full-task success rate of 40.9%, averaged over 3 self-evaluation rounds across all 100 tasks. On the official private test set, with 20 instances per task, our system achieves a mean Q-score of 0.615 and a full-task success rate of 41.2%.

摘要（中文）：本工作介绍了2026年BEHAVIOR挑战赛的亚军方案（IF1001团队），该挑战赛旨在评估跨100项家务任务的移动操作能力。我们的方法基于一个强大的世界动作模型（WAM）——Cosmos 3。我们通过更丰富的视觉历史、任务进度条件化以及任务组和技能特定的LoRA适配器对Cosmos 3进行了改进。在推理阶段，我们应用一个独立的进度估计器来提供任务进度上下文，并使用任务和进度条件化的路由来选择任务组或技能特定的策略，辅以动作候选聚合、滚动修补以及任务特定的时间控制和夹爪控制。为了满足最低1 FPS的推理要求，我们既未使用递归自我改进（RSI）也未使用智能体式编排方法，且不依赖任何闭源模型；在官方私有测试评估中，我们的系统在有限硬件资源下处理了跨100个评估端口的并发请求，每个端口的平均端到端推理速率维持在2 FPS以上。我们的方法在全部100项任务的3轮自评估中，平均Q分数达到0.613，完整任务成功率为40.9%。在官方私有测试集上，每项任务包含20个实例，我们的系统平均Q分数达到0.615，完整任务成功率为41.2%。

Authors: Yelin He, Jiaquan Ye, Xinming Wei, Wenjie Xiao, Gengming Zhang, Guoting Wei, Xianbiao Qi, Rong Xiao

From Depth to Safe Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Monocular Perception for Mobile Robot Navigation Perception3D

monocular depth uncertainty-aware safe depth mobile robot navigation conformal calibration

简要说明：该论文提出一种插件模块，将单目深度预测转换为用于移动机器人导航的安全深度边界，显著降低室内环境中的碰撞率。

TLDR: This paper presents a plug-in module that converts monocular depth predictions into safe depth bounds for mobile robot navigation, dramatically reducing collisions in indoor environments.

Abstract: Monocular depth foundation models make it tempting to replace depth sensors on mobile robots with a single RGB camera. We show that, used off the shelf, this is unsafe: in a simulated indoor navigation benchmark, a standard Nav2 stack driven by Depth Anything V2 (metric) collides in 63\% of 120 episodes, because the model systematically over-estimates the distance to nearby obstacles. We propose a lightweight plug-in module that turns predicted depth into \emph{safe depth}. A 0.58\,M-parameter head on top of the \emph{frozen} depth model predicts, per pixel, a log-depth correction $μ$ and an uncertainty $σ$, trained with a $β$-weighted Gaussian negative log-likelihood. The navigation stack consumes the one-sided bound $\hat d_{\text{safe}}=d\,e^{μ-kσ}$, where $k$ is set by conformal calibration on a held-out world, and uncertainty also decides which pixels may be treated as floor. The correction halves the depth error (AbsRel $0.262\rightarrow0.134$) and reduces near-range over-estimation from 59.8\% to 12.0\%. In navigation, safe depth raises the success rate from 37\% to 70\% and lowers collisions from 63\% to 3\%, close to the 2\% of ground-truth depth. A constant safety margin calibrated to the same pixel coverage reaches only 30\% success because it freezes the robot; uncertainty-aware safety wins 52 of 56 discordant paired episodes against it. Gains hold on glass, texture-less walls and dark regions.

摘要（中文）：单目深度基础模型使得用单个RGB相机替代移动机器人上的深度传感器变得颇具吸引力。我们的研究表明，直接使用此类模型并不安全：在模拟室内导航基准测试中，由Depth Anything V2（度量版）驱动的标准Nav2导航栈在120个测试场景中有63%发生碰撞，原因是该模型系统性地高估了附近障碍物的距离。我们提出了一种轻量级即插即用模块，将预测深度转化为*安全深度*。在*冻结*的深度模型之上，一个仅有0.58M参数的预测头逐像素输出对数深度修正量$μ$和不确定性$σ$，并通过$β$加权高斯负对数似然进行训练。导航栈使用单侧边界$\hat d_{\text{safe}}=d\,e^{μ-kσ}$，其中$k$通过在保留世界上的共形校准确定，同时不确定性还决定哪些像素可被视为地面。该修正将深度误差减半（AbsRel从0.262降至0.134），并将近距高估从59.8%降至12.0%。在导航中，安全深度将成功率从37%提升至70%，碰撞率从63%降至3%，接近于真实深度的2%。按照相同像素覆盖率校准的恒定安全裕度仅达到30%的成功率，因为它会使机器人停滞不前；而基于不确定性的安全方法在56个不一致的配对场景中赢得了52个。上述优势在玻璃、无纹理墙壁和黑暗区域中同样保持。

Authors: Saeid Firouzi Daghigh, Saeed Ayat

CIALLO: Learning Shared Intent Representations for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation VLA

cross-embodiment action codec manipulation VLA intent representation

简要说明：CIALLO 提出了一种动作编解码器，将动作、视觉变化和语言在共享意图空间中对齐，实现跨本体操作和快速适应，并在真实机器人和仿真中表现优异。

TLDR: CIALLO introduces an action codec that aligns actions, visual changes, and language in a shared intent space, enabling cross-embodiment manipulation with fast adaptation and strong performance on real robots and simulations.

Abstract: Robot demonstrations contain reusable manipulation knowledge, but transferring this knowledge across embodiments requires representations that bridge differences in control interfaces. Action reconstruction alone does not ensure that similar behaviors across robots share a representation. To address this gap, we introduce CIALLO, an action codec that aligns actions, visual changes, and observation-grounded language in a shared space of short-horizon behavioral intent. An embodiment-conditioned decoder maps this intent back to robot-specific actions, allowing a shared representation to support different control interfaces. After pretraining on eight embodiments, CIALLO adapts to a new robot from one recording of at most 10 seconds by updating only its embodiment embeddings. The calibrated codec then remains frozen while a policy learns to predict intent from observations and instructions. We instantiate this policy with Qwen3.5-4B to form Qwen-CIALLO, whose backbone requires no large-scale robot-action pretraining before policy finetuning. With 20 demonstrations per task, Qwen-CIALLO achieves 76.7\% average success across real SO-101 and single-arm Piper robots, compared with 70.0\% for fully finetuned $π_0$. In simulation, we additionally finetune the action decoder, achieving 97.3\% success on LIBERO and 52.7\% on RoboTwin 2.0. The LIBERO policy also achieves 80.8\% on LIBERO-Plus without further finetuning. Together, these results support a shared action codec as a transferable control interface that separates embodiment calibration from task learning.

摘要（中文）：机器人示教数据中蕴含着可复用的操作知识，但跨本体迁移这些知识需要能够弥合控制接口差异的表征方式。仅靠动作重建无法确保不同机器人上的相似行为共享同一表征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CIALLO——一种动作编解码器，将动作、视觉变化以及基于观测的语言对齐到短时程行为意图的共享空间中。一个以本体为条件的解码器将该意图映射回机器人特定动作，从而使共享表征能够支持不同的控制接口。在八个本体上进行预训练后，CIALLO仅通过更新其本体嵌入，即可从至多10秒的单段录制的数据中适应新机器人。校准后的编解码器保持冻结，而策略则学习从观测和指令中预测意图。我们以Qwen3.5-4B实例化该策略，构成Qwen-CIALLO，其主干网络在策略微调前无需大规模机器人动作预训练。在每任务20条演示的条件下，Qwen-CIALLO在真实SO-101和单臂Piper机器人上达到了76.7%的平均成功率，而完全微调的$π_0$为70.0%。在仿真中，我们进一步微调了动作解码器，在LIBERO上达到97.3%的成功率，在RoboTwin 2.0上达到52.7%。此外，LIBERO策略在无需进一步微调的情况下，在LIBERO-Plus上达到了80.8%的成功率。上述结果共同表明，共享动作编解码器作为一种可迁移的控制接口，能够将本体校准与任务学习相分离。

Authors: Choo Sin Wai, Dake Zhong, Jingye Zhang, Zhifang Liu, Siyao Xiao, Zirong Ding, Yuhong Zhang, Kangjie Chen, Dongbin Zhang, Guorui Song, Guocun Wang, Peng Jiao, Haoqian Wang

From Egocentric Human Video to Robot Manipulation in the Era of Embodied Intelligence Manipulation

egocentric video robot manipulation representation pretraining latent action modeling embodiment transfer

简要说明：本文形式化了Ego2Robot学习，定义了从第一视角人类视频迁移知识到机器人操作策略的四种范式，并回顾了相关数据集和挑战。

TLDR: This paper formalizes Ego2Robot learning, defining four paradigms for transferring knowledge from egocentric human video to robot manipulation policies, and reviews related datasets and challenges.

Abstract: Egocentric human video (EHV) records close-range hand-object interaction (HOI) and the temporal structure of everyday activities, offering a potentially scalable source of experience for robot manipulation. Using this experience for robot control requires recovering useful supervision without recorded robot actions and accounting for differences in morphology, viewpoint, and action space. We define Ego2Robot learning as the process of learning or adapting robot manipulation policies from EHV, organized into four learning paradigms: explicit embodiment transfer, explicit action and task supervision, egocentric video representation pretraining, and latent action and dynamics modeling. The four paradigms differ in what they derive from human video: robot-format demonstrations, interpretable supervision, visual representations, or predictive models of actions and dynamics. For each paradigm, we trace what EHV information is extracted, how robot policies use it, and when the additional data is required. Besides, we review the benchmark datasets that cover EHV, robot demonstrations, and synthetic and simulated resources. This paper links EHV data's contribution to the task information preserved and the robot-specific grounding used during training or deployment. Finally, we identify challenges in physical feasibility, agent coordination, in-context adaptation, controlled evaluation, and predictive control.

摘要（中文）：以自我为中心的人类视频（EHV）记录了近距离手物交互（HOI）及日常活动的时间结构，为机器人操作提供了一种潜在可扩展的经验来源。将这种经验用于机器人控制，需要在没有记录机器人动作的情况下恢复有用的监督信息，并考虑形态、视角和动作空间上的差异。我们将Ego2Robot学习定义为从EHV中学习或调整机器人操作策略的过程，并将其组织为四种学习范式：显式实体迁移、显式动作与任务监督、以自我为中心的视频表示预训练，以及潜在动作与动力学建模。这四种范式在从人类视频中提取的内容上有所不同：机器人格式的演示、可解释的监督信息、视觉表示，或动作与动力学的预测模型。针对每种范式，我们追踪了提取了哪些EHV信息、机器人策略如何使用这些信息，以及何时需要额外的数据。此外，我们回顾了涵盖EHV、机器人演示以及合成与模拟资源的基准数据集。本文建立了EHV数据的贡献与所保留的任务信息以及训练或部署过程中所使用的机器人特定基础之间的联系。最后，我们指出了物理可行性、智能体协调、情境内适应、受控评估和预测控制等方面面临的挑战。

Authors: Yi Wang, Jingqiu Wu, Lei Yao, Zhaoshuo Li, Haoyu Zhu, Yirui Zhou, Huaiyuan Xu, Ying Zheng, Chuang Yang, Lap-Pui Chau

Few-Shot Residual Adaptation of Pretrained Latent World Models WorldModel

few-shot adaptation latent world models residual correction self-supervised learning real robot

简要说明：本文提出一种针对预训练潜在世界模型的少样本残差适应方法，在无需修改预训练权重的情况下，使模型在物理动力学变化时恢复性能，并在真实机器人上取得高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a few-shot residual adaptation method for pretrained latent world models, enabling them to recover performance under physical dynamics shifts without modifying pretrained weights, achieving high success rates on real robots.

Abstract: Pretrained latent world models can support visual planning and control, but their predictions may fail when physical dynamics change at deployment. We study whether such models can adapt from only a few interactions without modifying their pretrained weights or identifying the changed physical parameters. We introduce a few-shot residual adaptation approach that learns self-supervised corrections from latent prediction errors. The corrections are applied both inside the latent predictor and directly to its predicted latent state, while the pretrained world model remains frozen. We evaluate the approach in simulation and on a real robot under center-of-mass and friction shifts. These changes reduce the success of the frozen model to near zero. Using three interaction episodes for adaptation, our dual-site approach recovers 90\% success under the center-of-mass shift and 100\% under the modified friction on the real robot. Ablations show that correcting both locations outperforms single-site adaptation. Our diagnostics further suggest that much of the learned correction reduces a general prediction mismatch, while successful control also depends on shift-specific information captured during adaptation.

摘要（中文）：预训练隐式世界模型能够支持视觉规划与控制，但在部署过程中物理动态发生变化时，其预测可能会失效。我们研究此类模型能否仅通过少量交互进行适应，而无需修改其预训练权重或识别发生变化的物理参数。我们提出了一种少样本残差适应方法，该方法从隐式预测误差中学习自监督修正。这些修正既应用于隐式预测器内部，也直接应用于其预测的隐式状态，同时保持预训练世界模型冻结不变。我们在仿真环境及真实机器人上，在质心偏移和摩擦变化条件下评估了该方法。这些变化使冻结模型的成功率降至接近零。利用三个交互片段进行适应后，我们的双位置方法在真实机器人上，质心偏移条件下恢复了90%的成功率，摩擦变化条件下恢复了100%的成功率。消融实验表明，同时修正两个位置优于单位置适应。我们的诊断进一步表明，学习到的修正大部分用于减少一般性预测失配，而成功的控制还依赖于适应过程中捕获的特定于变化的信息。

Authors: Jakub Suliga, Pankhuri Vanjani, Nisarga Nilavadi, Wolfram Burgard, Rudolf Lioutikov

Route-Time Conflict Maps for Cooperative End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

cooperative driving end-to-end driving intention sharing route-time conflict map order gate

简要说明：When2Go 是一个协作式端到端驾驶系统，在 CDA Class B 下共享意图（计划和预期轨迹），构建路线-时间冲突图，并利用基于路权的顺序门解决冲突，在多个 CARLA 基准上取得了最先进的驾驶分数。

TLDR: When2Go is a cooperative end-to-end driving system that shares intent (plans and intended trajectories) under CDA Class B, builds a route-time conflict map, and uses a right-of-way-based order gate to resolve conflicts, achieving state-of-the-art driving scores on several CARLA benchmarks.

Abstract: Existing cooperative end-to-end driving works at Class A (status-sharing) of the SAE J3216 classes of cooperative driving automation (CDA): vehicles exchange what they perceive, not what they intend, so each plans alone when to go, which limits cooperation and leads to deadlock when both vehicles yield or to collisions when both go. We present When2Go, a cooperative end-to-end driving system that learns when to go by sharing intent under CDA Class B or higher. Each vehicle broadcasts its LiDAR detections with forecast motion as instance tokens, together with its plan and intended trajectory. The receiver draws the fused detections, forecasts and partner plans into a route-time conflict map, the occupancy along its route over the planning horizon, on which a planner scores candidate speed profiles. Where two intended trajectories conflict, an order gate, a precedence network distilled from a right-of-way rule, decides who goes first; both vehicles evaluate it on the same messages and so reach the same order. When2Go imitates the rule-based expert of V2Xverse, which sees the simulator's ground truth; stops that When2Go cannot observe within its 2 s planning horizon are relabelled, so that it does not learn to wait without an observable cause. For our runs only, the benchmarks' PID controller steers by When2Go's waypoints instead of the route, and its forced push of long-waiting vehicles is off. With one model, When2Go sets the state of the art on three closed-loop CARLA benchmarks: 97.8 and 90.7 driving score on InterDrive without and with traffic (best published 90.1 and 78.9), 70.0 on the public V2Xverse protocol (best of sixteen rerun methods 59.1) and 88.2 on MDrive (best rerun 85.1), with 95.0% of its vehicles collision-free (87.7%).

摘要（中文）：现有的协同端到端驾驶工作属于SAE J3216协同驾驶自动化（CDA）类别中的A类（状态共享）：车辆交换的是各自感知到的信息，而非意图，因此每辆车各自独立规划何时出发，这限制了协同能力，并在双方同时让行时导致死锁，或在双方同时通行时导致碰撞。我们提出When2Go，一种协同端到端驾驶系统，通过CDA B类或更高等级下的意图共享来学习何时出发。每辆车广播其带有预测运动的LiDAR检测结果作为实例令牌，同时附带其计划和预期轨迹。接收方将融合后的检测结果、预测及合作方计划绘制为路线-时间冲突图，即规划时域内车辆路线上的占用情况，规划器基于该图对各候选速度曲线进行评分。当两条预期轨迹发生冲突时，一个通行权门控（order gate）——一种从路权规则中提炼的优先顺序网络——决定谁先通行；两辆车基于相同的消息进行判断，因此得出一致的通行顺序。When2Go模仿V2Xverse中基于规则的专家系统，该系统可获取模拟器的真实状态；对于When2Go在2秒规划时域内无法观测到的停车情况，系统会重新标注标签，以避免其在没有可观测原因的情况下学习等待。仅针对我们的测试场景，基准测试中的PID控制器根据When2Go的路径点而非原始路线进行转向，且其强制推动长时间等待车辆的功能被关闭。仅使用单一模型，When2Go在三个闭环CARLA基准测试中均达到最先进水平：在InterDrive无交通和含交通场景下分别取得97.8和90.7的驾驶得分（此前最佳公开结果为90.1和78.9），在公开V2Xverse测试协议中取得70.0分（十六个重跑方法中的最佳为59.1），在MDrive上取得88.2分（最佳重跑为85.1），其中95.0%的车辆实现无碰撞（此前为87.7%）。

Authors: Haohua Que, Mingkai Liu, Tianle Zhu, Zhipeng Bao, Yiping Li, Handong Yao

Curie's Jarvis: Autonomous Robotic Chemistry Experiments from Printed Protocols Manipulation

printed protocol reading label-based container identification bench chemistry automation real robot manipulation multi-view perception

简要说明：Curie's Jarvis 使 Franka Panda 机械臂能够通过读取打印协议、在多个摄像头视角下读取标签以区分相同容器，并在每一步前重新定位目标，从而自主执行化学实验，无需人工干预，成功率较高。

TLDR: Curie's Jarvis enables a Franka Panda robot arm to autonomously execute chemistry experiments from printed protocols by reading instructions, distinguishing identical containers via label reading in multiple camera views, and re-localizing targets before each step, achieving high success rates without human intervention.

Abstract: A person running a bench experiment works from a printed instruction sheet, tells identical containers apart by the labels written on them, and looks at the bench again before each step. Lab automation usually works the other way around: the procedure is written as a script, and containers stand at fixed positions or carry fiducial markers. We present Curie's Jarvis, a system that lets a robot arm carry out a chemistry experiment on a bench set up for people. It reads the steps from a photo of the printed sheet, finds containers on an ordinary bench with no fixed positions or markers, tells identical-looking containers apart by reading their labels in four camera views, locates its target again before every step, and sets how each step is carried out, including its speed, from what is being handled. On a Franka Panda arm, Curie's Jarvis completed 5 of 5 runs of one protocol from a children's chemistry kit and 4 of 5 runs of another, with no human intervention, and in 160 locates on printed and handwritten labels it identified every container correctly. This brings robots a step closer to doing bench chemistry the way people do.

摘要（中文）：操作台实验的操作人员依据打印的说明书进行操作，通过标签区分相同的容器，并在每一步操作前再次查看操作台。而实验室自动化通常采用相反的方式：程序以脚本形式编写，容器固定位置或带有基准标记。我们提出了Curie's Jarvis系统，该系统能使机器人手臂在专为人类设计的操作台上执行化学实验。系统从打印说明书的照片中读取步骤，在无固定位置或标记的普通操作台上定位容器，通过四个相机视角读取标签来区分外观相同的容器，在每一步操作前重新定位目标，并根据处理对象设定每一步的执行方式，包括速度。在Franka Panda机械臂上，Curie's Jarvis在儿童化学套装的一个方案中5次运行全部成功，另一个方案中5次运行成功4次，全程无需人工干预；在对打印和手写标签的160次定位中，所有容器均被正确识别。这使机器人向像人类一样进行台架化学实验的目标迈进了一步。

Authors: Rumi Loghmani, Bozhang Song, Victor Alvarado, Aliyah Redding, Amir Barati Farimani

Ground Reaction Force-Aware Model Predictive Control for Underactuated Upright Physical Assistance HumanoidEmbodied

Model Predictive Control Ground Reaction Force Centroidal Dynamics Physical Assistance Underactuated Cable Robot

简要说明：本文提出GRF-MPC框架，将实时地面反作用力和压力中心测量融入人体质心动力学模型，用于直立物理辅助。在欠驱动4缆绳机器人上部署，并在近300次人体试验中，相较于全驱动8缆绳阻抗基线，在降低跟踪误差、所需功和增加自愿活动范围方面表现更优。

TLDR: This paper presents GRF-MPC, a model predictive control framework that integrates live ground reaction force and center of pressure measurements into a human centroidal dynamics model for upright physical assistance. Deployed on an underactuated 4-cable robot, it outperforms a fully actuated 8-cable impedance baseline in reducing tracking errors, required work, and increasing voluntary excursion area across nearly 300 human trials.

Abstract: Many rehabilitation robots execute prescribed motions using reactive tracking controllers that do not explicitly incorporate the user's instantaneous human-ground interaction. This paper presents Ground Reaction Force-Aware Model Predictive Control (GRF-MPC), a framework for upright physical assistance. By integrating live GRF and center of pressure (CoP) measurements directly into a human centroidal dynamics model, GRF-MPC formulates a real-time quadratic program (QP) that optimizes assistive forces and moments over a receding horizon. We deployed GRF-MPC on the Robotic Upright Stand Trainer (RobUST) in an underactuated 4-cable configuration and evaluated it against a fully actuated 8-cable Cartesian impedance baseline in nearly 300 trials across six healthy participants. Across tasks spanning impulsive perturbations, lunge trajectories, and voluntary limits of stability, GRF-MPC reduced peak planar center-of-mass (CoM) error by 19.6% during perturbations, lowered trajectory tracking error by 24.1%, required 28.7% less net mechanical work, and permitted a 45.9% greater normalized voluntary excursion area. The underlying QP solves in under 1 ms, comfortably enabling 100 Hz replanning and demonstrating that incorporating live human-ground interaction into predictive control yields stronger, more transparent physical assistance with half the actuators.

摘要（中文）：许多康复机器人在执行指定动作时，采用的是反应式跟踪控制器，这类控制器并未显式纳入用户瞬时的人-地交互信息。本文提出了一种基于地面反作用力的模型预测控制（GRF-MPC）框架，用于直立状态下的物理辅助。通过将实时地面反作用力（GRF）与压力中心（CoP）测量值直接集成到人体质心动力学模型中，GRF-MPC构建了一个实时二次规划（QP）问题，在滚动时域内优化辅助力与力矩。我们在欠驱动四缆配置的机器直立训练器（RobUST）上部署了GRF-MPC，并在六名健康受试者参与的近300次试验中，将其与全驱动八缆笛卡尔阻抗基线进行了对比评估。在涵盖冲击扰动、弓步轨迹和自主稳定性极限的任务中，GRF-MPC在扰动期间的峰值平面质心（CoM）误差降低了19.6%，轨迹跟踪误差降低了24.1%，净机械功需求减少了28.7%，并允许归一化自主活动范围扩大45.9%。其底层QP求解耗时不足1毫秒，可轻松实现100赫兹的重新规划，表明将实时人-地交互纳入预测控制，可在仅使用一半执行器的情况下，提供更强、更透明的物理辅助。

Authors: Darren Biskup, Jeonghan Yu, Zibo Yu, Sunil K. Agrawal

How Much of Your VLA Is kNN VLA

kNN retrieval Vision-Language-Action model LIBERO benchmark Local Action Consistency fine-tuning analysis

简要说明：本文表明，在LIBERO基准上，简单的k近邻演示动作检索无需训练即可达到91.7%的成功率，且在扰动下优于许多VLA模型；同时提出了局部动作一致性（LAC）指标来衡量和指导检索策略的性能。

TLDR: This paper shows that simple k-nearest-neighbor retrieval of demonstration actions achieves 91.7% success on LIBERO without training, outperforming many VLAs under perturbations, and introduces Local Action Consistency (LAC) to measure and guide retrieval-based policy performance.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models now exceed 95% success on the LIBERO simulation benchmark, yet it remains unclear how much of this performance requires generalization beyond the training demonstrations. In this work, we show that retrieving nearby demonstrations and reusing their action chunks achieves a success rate of 91.7 % on LIBERO without policy training. Under LIBERO-Plus perturbations, retrieval shows the smallest drop of all evaluated policies. Across nine publicly available VLAs, fine-tuning mostly makes the vision-language backbone a better retrieval key, and the actions of the VLAs remain close to the demonstrations. In addition, we introduce Local Action Consistency (LAC), an offline metric that measures whether nearby observations in representation space are also associated with similar future actions. We show that LAC tracks the success rate of retrieval and can guide the training of a retrieval key. Our evaluation and source code are available at https://github.com/sereact/lerobot_knn.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在LIBERO仿真基准上的成功率现已超过95%，然而，在这些性能中，有多少依赖于超越训练示范之外的泛化能力，目前仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们展示了在未进行策略训练的情况下，通过检索相近示范并复用其动作片段，在LIBERO上可实现91.7%的成功率。在LIBERO-Plus扰动条件下，检索方法在所有评估策略中性能下降幅度最小。对九个公开可用的VLA模型进行微调后，视觉-语言骨干网络主要成为更好的检索键，且VLA的动作输出仍与示范保持接近。此外，我们引入了局部动作一致性（LAC）这一离线指标，用于衡量表示空间中相近的观测是否对应相似的未来动作。我们证明，LAC能够反映检索成功率的变化，并可指导检索键的训练。我们的评估结果和源代码可在 https://github.com/sereact/lerobot_knn 获取。

Authors: Denis Grachev, Damien LaRocque, Omar Moured

Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation Manipulation

tactile foundation model heterogeneous tactile representation dexterous manipulation vision-language-action (VLA) diffusion policy

简要说明：本文提出了LingBot-Touch，一种触觉基础模型，学习跨异构触觉传感器（压阻式、磁式和视触觉）的统一表示，并可作为即插即用的token无缝集成到多种策略模型（扩散策略、VLA模型）中，在仿真和真实机器人上提升灵巧操作性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model that learns a unified representation across heterogeneous tactile sensors (piezoresistive, magnetic, visuotactile) and integrates seamlessly as plug-and-play tokens into various policy models (diffusion policy, VLA models), enhancing dexterous manipulation performance in simulation and real robots.

Abstract: Tactile sensing is an indispensable modality for contact-rich dexterous manipulation, a capability that hints at the ultimate frontiers of embodied intelligence. However, commercially available tactile sensors are still at a relatively early stage of development, with each type of sensor offering irreplaceable strengths alongside its own drawbacks. A key challenge is thus to free tactile understanding from sensor-specific physics, so that embodied models can effectively leverage heterogeneous tactile data. To this end, we develop LingBot-Touch, a tactile foundation model characterized by the following properties. (i) Our model yields a unified representation across different tactile sensors (i.e., piezoresistive, magnetic, and visuotactile sensors), and is easily extensible to new sensor types. (ii) The resulting tactile tokens are plug-and-play: they can be seamlessly integrated into policy models across paradigms, from diffusion policy to vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA, consistently enhancing manipulation dexterity. (iii) Extensive experiments, spanning simulation and real-robot deployments across multiple hardware platforms, demonstrate that our tactile representation substantially benefits complex manipulation tasks while maintaining strong computational efficiency. We believe the findings in this work demonstrate the potential of leveraging cross-sensor data to scale tactile learning, and offer encouraging insights for the design of future hardware and embodied models.

摘要（中文）：触觉传感是实现富含接触的灵巧操作不可或缺的模态，这一能力预示着具身智能的最终前沿。然而，目前市售的触觉传感器仍处于相对早期的发展阶段，每种传感器在提供不可替代优势的同时也伴随着自身的缺陷。因此，一个关键挑战是如何将触觉理解从特定传感器的物理特性中解放出来，从而使具身模型能够有效利用异构触觉数据。为此，我们开发了LingBot-Touch，一个具有以下特性的触觉基础模型：（i）我们的模型在不同触觉传感器（即压阻式、磁式和视觉触觉传感器）之间产生统一表示，并且易于扩展到新型传感器；（ii）产生的触觉标记即插即用：它们可以无缝集成到跨范式的策略模型中，从扩散策略到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（如$π_{0.5}$和LingBot-VLA），持续增强操作灵巧性；（iii）大量实验涵盖仿真和多种硬件平台上的真实机器人部署，表明我们的触觉表示在保持强大计算效率的同时，显著有益于复杂操作任务。我们相信本研究的发现展示了利用跨传感器数据扩展触觉学习的潜力，并为未来硬件和具身模型的设计提供了鼓舞人心的见解。

Authors: Bing Han, Yichuan Peng, Haoyu Dong, Yuanmeng Hu, Yongyi Jia, Fangjing Wang, Kecheng Zheng, Yiming Zhang, Yanhong Zeng, Xiaoqing Zhang, Chen Song, Rundong Zou, Anqi Dong, Yuan Guan, Ka Leong Cheng, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Nan Xue, Wei Ning

Building World Models from Intrinsic Motivation WorldModel

intrinsic motivation world models model-based reinforcement learning representation learning zero-shot transfer

简要说明：本文将24种内在动机目标整合到基于模型的强化学习框架中，研究它们对世界模型学习的影响，并通过运动、操作和游戏环境中的零样本/少样本及多任务控制进行评估，同时考察三种表示学习策略，结果表明好奇心和新奇驱动探索能改善迁移与适应。

TLDR: This paper integrates 24 intrinsic motivation objectives into a model-based RL framework to study how they affect world-model learning, evaluating the resulting models via zero/few-shot and multi-task control in locomotion, manipulation, and gaming; it also examines three representation-learning strategies and shows that curiosity and novelty-driven exploration can improve transfer and adaptation.

Abstract: In the absence of extrinsic rewards or task supervision, human behavior is guided by intrinsic motivation---neural signals that drive curiosity, creativity, play, and other essential facets of intelligence. Intrinsic motivation plays an important developmental role in building robust world models that enable generalization and adaptation. Yet existing studies leave open how a broad range of intrinsic motivations interacts with world-model representation learning to support downstream control. This limits our understanding of which intrinsically collected experiences build reusable models. To address these gaps, we integrate 24 intrinsic objectives, including established methods and explicit variants spanning curiosity, entropy, and competency, into a common model-based reinforcement learning framework. We evaluate the world models they build through zero-shot, few-shot, and multi-task control in locomotion, manipulation, and open-ended gaming environments, using three representation-learning strategies: observation reconstruction, latent prediction, and redundancy reduction. Curiosity-driven exploration with observation reconstruction yields the strongest aggregate family profile, although the best individual pairing depends on the experiment. In compositional vision-based tasks, intrinsic motivation derived from both episodic and lifelong novelty---providing a complementary memory to the world model's generic recurrent state---achieves the best zero-shot transfer and few-shot adaptation. These findings motivate designing intrinsic motivation and representation learning jointly. Our results demonstrate world models as a powerful tool for measuring the quality of intrinsically motivated experience, and positions intrinsic motivation as a key ingredient for building world models autonomously.

摘要（中文）：在缺乏外部奖励或任务监督的情况下，人类行为由内在动机引导——即驱动好奇心、创造力、游戏以及其他智能核心要素的神经信号。内在动机在构建支持泛化与适应的稳健世界模型中发挥着重要的发展性作用。然而，现有研究尚未阐明广泛的内在动机类型如何与世界模型表征学习相互作用以支持下游控制，这限制了我们理解哪些由内在驱动的经验能够构建可复用的模型。为弥补上述空白，我们将24种内在目标——包括已有方法及涵盖好奇心、熵和能力维度的显式变体——整合进统一的基于模型强化学习框架中。通过零样本、少样本及多任务控制在运动、操作和开放式游戏环境中的评估，我们考察了其构建的世界模型，并采用三种表征学习策略：观测重建、潜在预测和冗余削减。结合观测重建的好奇心驱动探索整体上表现出最强的家族特征，尽管最优的个体配对因实验而异。在基于视觉的组合任务中，源自情景新奇性和终身新奇性的内在动机——为世界模型的通用循环状态提供互补记忆——在零样本迁移和少样本适应中取得了最佳表现。这些发现提示应将内在动机与表征学习进行联合设计。我们的结果证明了世界模型是衡量内在动机驱动经验质量的有效工具，并将内在动机定位为自主构建世界模型的关键要素。

Authors: Reece Keller, Declan Kutscher, Xaq Pitkow, Aran Nayebi

OnlyAct: Extracting Action Representations from Foundation Models for World Models WorldModel

action representation contrastive adaptation world models V-JEPA 2 scene invariance

简要说明：本文提出OnlyAct，一种无标签对比适应框架，从预训练基础模型（V-JEPA 2）的嵌入中提取动作表示，用于世界模型，在机器人操作、导航、游戏和驾驶基准上实现了更好的动作表达性和场景不变性。

TLDR: This paper introduces OnlyAct, a label-free contrastive adaptation framework that extracts action representations from pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2) embeddings for world models, enabling better action expressiveness and scene invariance across robot manipulation, navigation, game, and driving benchmarks.

Abstract: Video world models promise general-purpose interactive simulators, but their training is limited by action supervision: action labels are scarce, fragmented across incompatible specifications, and do not scale with the unlabeled video pretraining corpus. A common workaround jointly trains an action encoder to compress consecutive frames into a latent action and a decoder to reconstruct the next frame from the previous frame and that latent, forcing the latent to capture only new information. This has two limitations: learning the action space from scratch can limit generalization to unseen domains, and the bottleneck trades expressiveness for separation, with tighter settings losing nuance and looser ones risking scene leakage under domain shifts. We argue for a different starting point: rather than learning actions from scratch, we start from a pretrained foundation model (V-JEPA 2), whose embeddings of a frame pair already carry substantial action information after large-scale, diverse video pretraining. The remaining challenge is to extract the action while discarding the scene. We propose a label-free contrastive adaptation framework that pulls together frame pairs sharing the same motion under a different scene and pushes apart pairs from the same scene with different motion, reshaping the geometry of the pretrained space without imposing a reconstruction bottleneck. We introduce a unified evaluation protocol along three axes (action expressiveness, scene invariance, and action-conditioned video generation quality) across robot manipulation, camera navigation, game, and driving benchmarks, most of which are unseen during adaptation. Compared with annotation-free latent-action methods, our representations are substantially more expressive while matching their scene invariance, and they yield world models that transfer demonstrated actions to new scenes more faithfully.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型有望成为通用的交互式模拟器，但其训练受到动作监督的限制：动作标签稀缺，分散在不兼容的规格中，且无法随无标签视频预训练语料库扩展。一种常见的变通方案是联合训练一个动作编码器，将连续帧压缩为潜在动作，以及一个解码器，根据前一帧和该潜在动作重建下一帧，从而迫使潜在表示仅捕获新信息。这有两个局限性：从零开始学习动作空间可能限制对未见领域的泛化能力；且瓶颈在表达力与分离性之间取舍，更紧的设置会丢失细微差别，而更松的设置则在领域偏移下面临场景泄漏的风险。我们主张采用不同的出发点：并非从零学习动作，而是从预训练基础模型（V-JEPA 2）出发，该模型在大规模、多样化的视频预训练后，其帧对嵌入已携带大量动作信息。剩余的挑战在于提取动作的同时丢弃场景。我们提出一种无标签对比适应框架，将不同场景下具有相同运动的帧对拉近，同时将同一场景中具有不同运动的帧对推远，从而在不施加重建瓶颈的情况下重塑预训练空间的几何结构。我们引入了一套统一的评估协议，沿三个维度（动作表达力、场景不变性以及动作条件视频生成质量）在机器人操作、相机导航、游戏和驾驶基准上进行评估，其中大多数基准在适应过程中未被见过。与无标注潜在动作方法相比，我们的表示在保持其场景不变性的同时更具表达力，并能产生更忠实地将示范动作迁移至新场景的世界模型。

Authors: Runjia Li, Minghao Chen, Junyu Xie, Philip Torr, Andrea Vedaldi, Tomas Jakab

A human-in-the-loop Control Paradigm for Construction Robotics: From VR-Guided Teleoperation to Semi-Autonomous Dual-Arm Operation Manipulation

human-in-the-loop shared control teleoperation dual-arm manipulation construction robotics

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向建筑机器人的人机协同控制范式，融合了VR引导遥操作、半自主共享控制和基于规则的自主执行，并在双臂立面安装任务中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a human-in-the-loop control paradigm for construction robots that integrates VR-guided teleoperation, semi-autonomous shared control, and rule-based autonomous execution, validated on dual-arm facade-installation tasks.

Abstract: Construction tasks in hazardous and unstructured environments require both human adaptability and robotic precision, yet existing approaches often treat teleoperation and autonomy as separate control modes. This paper presents a human-in-the-loop control paradigm that enables structured transitions among VR-guided teleoperation, semi-autonomous shared control, and rule-based autonomous execution for contact-rich dual-arm construction tasks. The proposed system combines immersive VR guidance, a manually defined library of reusable skill primitives, and a shared-autonomy framework with explicit human-robot role allocation and command-priority rules. This integration allows operators to retain supervisory and corrective authority while delegating repetitive and precision-critical actions to the robot. The paradigm is validated on a dual-arm platform through representative facade-installation tasks. Results show that autonomous execution provides the best performance under well-calibrated nominal conditions, whereas semi-autonomous control improves resilience when environmental disturbances exceed the predefined autonomous pipeline's correction capability. Semi-autonomous control also substantially reduces subjective operator workload compared with full teleoperation. These findings demonstrate that effective construction-robot control should adapt human involvement to task and environmental uncertainty, using autonomy for repeatable operations and shared control for disturbance recovery.

摘要（中文）：在危险且非结构化环境中的施工作业，既需要人类的适应能力，也需要机器人的精准性，然而现有方法往往将遥操作与自主控制视为两种相互独立的控制模式。本文提出了一种人在回路的控制范式，支持在VR引导的遥操作、半自主共享控制以及基于规则的自主执行之间实现结构化切换，以应对接触丰富的双臂施工任务。该系统融合了沉浸式VR引导、人工定义的可复用技能原语库，以及具有明确人机角色分配和指令优先级规则的共享自主框架。该集成方案使操作员能够保留监督和纠错权限，同时将重复性和精度关键性操作委托给机器人执行。该范式在双臂平台上通过具有代表性的幕墙安装任务进行了验证。结果表明，在标定良好的标称条件下，自主执行具有最佳性能；而当环境扰动超出预设自主流水线的修正能力时，半自主控制则能更好地提升系统鲁棒性。与完全遥操作相比，半自主控制还显著降低了操作员的主观工作负荷。这些研究结果表明，有效的施工机器人控制应根据任务与环境不确定性调整人的参与程度，在可重复操作中采用自主执行，在扰动恢复中采用共享控制。

Authors: Jinhua Chen, Xiaoji Xu, Zhongyuan Liao, Huang Zhenmin, Zhang Ye, Changying Xiang

RedirectMimic: Local Motion Content Redaction for Humanoid Whole-Body Control HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid whole-body control motion redaction reinforcement learning tracking control Unitree G1

简要说明：RedirectMimic 提出了一种训练时方法，将智能体观测的参考动作与用于奖励计算的目标分离，从而在保持整体跟踪性能的同时实现局部动作内容替换（例如抑制举臂动作）。

TLDR: RedirectMimic introduces a training-time method that separates the reference motion observed by the actor from the target used for reward computation, enabling local motion content redaction (e.g., suppressing overhead-arm movements) while preserving overall tracking performance in humanoid whole-body control.

Abstract: Humanoid motion interfaces should accommodate application-specific movement constraints while retaining useful reference behavior. Local content redaction requires a controller to replace selected movements even when it continues to receive the original reference. Removing the tracking incentive for those movements leaves their replacement unspecified. We introduce RedirectMimic, which separates the reference observed by the actor from the target used to train its execution. A rule-generated edited reference guides tracking rewards during proximal policy optimization, while the deployed observation and action interfaces remain unchanged. We evaluate pose- and speed-defined arm editing in Unitree G1 simulation using a tracker pretrained on 7,509 motion clips. On the overhead-arm task, RedirectMimic reduces core-window content occurrence to 2.7%, compared with 58.9% for reward zeroing and 32.8% for anti-tracking. It achieves 94.2% core-window joint success, combining content suppression, fall-free execution, and local retention. On the speed-defined task, fast outward arm movements occurred at similarly low rates under all three local editing methods. Across both tasks, RedirectMimic achieved the lowest replacement error among these methods and tracked unedited motions with accuracy comparable to that of the pretrained controller. Project page: https://xiaopeng-whu.github.io/RedirectMimic/.

摘要（中文）：类人动作界面应当能够适应特定应用场景下的动作约束，同时保留有价值的参考行为。局部内容遮蔽要求控制器在仍然接收原始参考的情况下，替换选定的动作。移除对这些动作的跟踪激励，会使其替换行为处于未定义状态。我们提出RedirectMimic，它将策略网络观测的参考信号与用于训练其执行的目标信号分开处理。在近端策略优化过程中，规则生成的编辑后参考引导跟踪奖励，而部署时的观测与动作接口保持不变。我们在Unitree G1仿真中，利用在7，509个动作片段上预训练的跟踪器，评估了姿态定义和速度定义的臂部编辑任务。在抬臂过顶任务中，RedirectMimic将核心窗口内的内容出现率降低至2.7%，而奖励置零方法为58.9%，反跟踪方法为32.8%。RedirectMimic实现了94.2%的核心窗口关节成功，综合了内容抑制、无摔倒执行和局部保持三方面目标。在速度定义的任务中，三种局部编辑方法下，快速外展臂动作的发生率均处于相近的低水平。在两个任务中，RedirectMimic均实现了最低的替换误差，同时对未编辑动作的跟踪精度与预训练控制器相当。项目主页：https://xiaopeng-whu.github.io/RedirectMimic/。

Authors: Zepeng Wang, Xiaochuan Shi

Optimization-Based Path Planning for Industrial Manipulators: Experimental Validation in Additive Manufacturing Manipulation

path planning optimization-based industrial manipulators additive manufacturing self-collision

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向工业机械臂增材制造的离线优化路径规划方法，结合关节路径规则性、自碰撞惩罚和工艺特定约束，并在UR10e上通过碳纤维缠绕和3D打印进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an offline optimization-based path planner for industrial manipulators in robotic additive manufacturing, combining joint-path regularity, self-collision penalties, and process-specific costs, validated on a UR10e for carbon-fiber winding and 3D printing.

Abstract: Robotic additive manufacturing requires joint paths that reconcile robot feasibility with process-specific geometry. We develop an offline optimization-based path planner that combines joint-path regularity and self-collision penalties with process costs and constraints, so that a new process enters through its own reference, residuals, and tolerances. Full-path and boundary-coupled chunked optimization handle references of different lengths. Iterative Weight Tuning (IWT) determines the cost weights from the gaps between Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and their targets. In carbon-fiber winding and robotic 3D printing, the planned paths meet the geometric tolerances and all KPI targets, and both paths are executed on a UR10e, without extrusion for printing, with joint-level tracking recorded during execution.

摘要（中文）：机器人增材制造要求关节路径能够兼顾机器人可行性与工艺特定几何形状。我们开发了一种基于离线优化的路径规划器，将关节路径规则性和自碰撞惩罚与工艺成本及约束相结合，从而使新工艺通过其自身的参考量、残差和公差引入。全路径及边界耦合的分块优化处理不同长度的参考量。迭代权重调整（IWT）根据关键性能指标（KPI）与其目标值之间的差距确定成本权重。在碳纤维缠绕和机器人3D打印中，规划路径满足几何公差及所有KPI目标，且两条路径均在UR10e机器人上执行，打印过程不进行挤出，执行期间记录关节级跟踪数据。
