Authors: Shiva Ganesh Murali, Valentin Bhend, Deepak Ingole, Gabriele Fadini, Alisa Rupenyan

Persistent Metric-Semantic Maritime Scene Memory from Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs Perception3D

3D scene graphs open-vocabulary metric-semantic mapping VLM reasoning maritime robotics

简要说明：本文将室外开放词汇3D场景图适配到海洋环境，通过度量-语义整合和基于几何的多视图VLM推理，减少实体碎片化，并为机器人空间推理创建持久场景记忆。

TLDR: This paper adapts outdoor open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs to maritime environments by adding metric-semantic consolidation and geometry-grounded multi-view VLM reasoning, reducing entity fragmentation and creating persistent scene memory for robot spatial reasoning.

Abstract: Three-dimensional scene graphs (3DSGs) can provide robots with persistent metric-semantic representations for spatial reasoning, but the existing methods have primarily been developed for indoor and terrestrial environments. In this paper we investigate how a representative outdoor open-vocabulary method transfers to maritime environments and which adaptations are needed. Our experiments show that zero-shot representative outdoor 3DSG descriptions agree with our labeled ground truth for a majority of geometry-supported objects on our data, but the resulting map exhibits considerable physical-entity fragmentation, and its terrestrial higher-level assumptions don't capture maritime spatial organization needs. We therefore keep the underlying mapping method and post-process its accumulated evidence. We show a metric-semantic consolidation method followed by geometry-grounded multi-view vision-language model (VLM) reasoning that reconciles remaining fragments into physical entities and groups entities through observations into local places. In parallel, we construct maritime macro regions using map priors and onboard water and structure observations, and associate them with the local places. The resulting representation reduces physical-entity fragmentation beyond both the baseline and our geometry-semantic consolidation component alone, supports correspondence of fixed local places across repeated maritime traversals, and improves contextual retrieval on our reviewed queries over tested baselines. These results show how an outdoor open-vocabulary map can be adapted into persistent maritime scene memory with our methods for object/place identity and spatial abstractions.

摘要（中文）：三维场景图（3DSG）能够为机器人提供用于空间推理的持久度量-语义表示，但现有方法主要针对室内和地面环境开发。本文研究了一种具有代表性的户外开放词汇方法如何迁移至海上环境，以及需要进行哪些适配。实验表明，零样本的典型户外3DSG描述在我们的数据上与多数几何支撑物体的标注真值一致，但生成的图谱存在显著的物理实体碎片化问题，且其基于地面场景的高层假设无法满足海上空间组织的需求。因此，我们保留底层建图方法，并对其累积证据进行后处理。我们提出了一种度量-语义整合方法，随后通过基于几何约束的多视角视觉语言模型（VLM）推理，将剩余碎片归并为物理实体，并依据观测将实体分组为局部场所。与此同时，我们利用地图先验以及船载水面和结构观测构建海上宏观区域，并将其与局部场所关联。最终生成的表示不仅相比基线和单独的几何-语义整合组件显著减少了物理实体碎片化，还支持重复海上航行中固定局部场所的对应匹配，并在我们所审查的查询任务中相较于测试基线提升了上下文检索性能。上述结果表明，通过我们所提出的物体/场所身份标识及空间抽象方法，可将户外开放词汇地图适配为持久的海上场景记忆。

Authors: Kim Alexander Christensen, Dina Zimmermann, Martin Steinert, Eleni Kelasidi

Camera equalisation of an 11.5x drop in environmental illuminance: four imitation-learning policies on an SO-101 arm Manipulation

imitation learning real robot illuminance ACT Diffusion Policy

简要说明：本文在真实机器人臂上评估了四种模仿学习策略在环境光照下降11.5倍时的表现，发现相机自动曝光/白平衡在很大程度上补偿了光照变化，单独使用勒克斯并不能很好地描述策略的视觉条件。

TLDR: This paper empirically evaluates four imitation-learning policies under an 11.5x drop in environmental illuminance on a real robot arm, finding that automatic camera exposure/white balance largely compensates for lighting changes and that lux alone poorly describes visual conditions for learned policies.

Abstract: Real-robot benchmarks of learned visuomotor policies often record room illuminance as the lighting condition. We show that, on a typical low-cost rig, room light and image light can be almost unrelated. Four imitation-learning policies (ACT, SmolVLA, Diffusion Policy and pi0.5) were trained on the same 50 demonstrations of a pick-and-place task on an SO-101 arm. Each was run for ten rollouts at about 520 lux and again at about 45 lux, an 11.5x reduction. Success was 20/40 in normal light and 19/40 in low light: a change of -2.5 percentage points (95% CI -23 to +19), with no evidence that the policies differed in sensitivity (interaction p = 0.86). The recorded video shows why: mean image brightness was only 3% lower in low light on the front camera and 19% lower on the wrist camera. Both cameras were set to automatic exposure and white balance, which most likely absorbed the difference; exposure was not locked in this experiment. An accidental repeat of one 10-rollout block reproduced its success count (7/10) but matched the first block at only 6 of 10 placements, consistent with chance. We conclude that lux alone does not describe what a policy sees. Camera settings, and image statistics compared with the training recordings, are the quantities to report and control. Data and code are public.

摘要（中文）：真实机器人学习视觉运动策略的基准测试中，通常将室内照度记录为光照条件。我们发现在典型低成本设备上，室内光照与图像光照可能几乎不相关。我们在SO-101机械臂上，使用同一组50次抓取放置任务的演示数据，训练了四种模仿学习策略（ACT、SmolVLA、Diffusion Policy和pi0.5）。每种策略在约520勒克斯和约45勒克斯（降低11.5倍）条件下各执行十次 rollout。正常光照下成功率为20/40，低光照下为19/40，变化为-2.5个百分点（95%置信区间-23至+19），且无证据表明各策略在灵敏度上存在差异（交互作用p=0.86）。录制视频揭示了原因：低光条件下，前置摄像头平均图像亮度仅降低3%，腕部摄像头降低19%。两台摄像头均设置为自动曝光和自动白平衡，这很可能吸收了差异；本实验中未锁定曝光。一次偶然重复的10次rollout模块重现了其成功率（7/10），但仅在第一模块的10次放置中匹配了6次，与随机结果一致。我们得出结论：仅凭勒克斯值无法描述策略实际所见。摄像头设置及与训练录制图像统计数据的对比，才是应报告和控制的参数。数据和代码已公开。

Authors: Simon Cowling

Softness is something you also need! Why compliance helps control: information metrics of a passive walker with compliant ankle Locomotion

compliance passive dynamic walking morphological computation phase-space volume information metrics

简要说明：本文主张机器人学应向生物启发的软体、柔顺代理范式转变，并提出了利用信息度量和RKHS方法对带柔顺脚踝的被动步行器进行相空间体积计算的技术说明。

TLDR: This paper argues for a paradigm shift in robotics toward soft, compliant agents inspired by biology, and presents a technical note on phase-space volume calculations for passive walkers with compliant ankles using information metrics and RKHS methods.

Abstract: A great gap in adaptivity, flexibility, and dexterity still exists between intelligent robots, whether they are made of rigid or (partially) compliant components, and their naturally evolved animal and vegetal counterparts. One reason could be of `paradigm' nature. On the one hand, most robots (both rigid and soft) are still designed by following a `Cartesian' approach, with top-down control and a clear mind-body separation. Designing artificial agents on the basis of the principles that we observe in biology is not an easy task. The principles of organization of animals and plants rely on morphological computation and emergence of fit behaviors from loosely coupled networks of embodied agents. Modeling and control require radically new approaches. In this paper we briefly recall and explain some seminal mathematical results linking information metrics and dynamics of the agents, already published years ago; we integrate them with some recent methods developed by us and by the community, we highlight some brief remarks about their relevance and we hint to our current and near future work towards finding concrete and efficient ways for the modeling and control of completely or partially compliant artificial agents and for a better understanding of physical intelligence in nature. We present a technical note summarizing phase-space volume calculations for inverted-pendulum and passive-dynamic walking models, following our proposed framework. Starting from the McGeer compass gait, we introduce knee-ankle compliance, foot-rocker effects, and a Ruina-style compass gait with distributed leg inertia. Standard heel-strike maps are derived and used in the estimation of viable phase-space volumes $W(γ)$, based on a state-dependent Monte-Carlo and Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces methods. We show how the methods based on RKHS allow deeper and more subtle analysis.

摘要（中文）：智能机器人，无论是刚性的还是（部分）柔顺的，在适应性、灵活性和灵巧性方面与自然进化的动物和植物相比，仍存在巨大差距。原因之一或许在于“范式”本质。一方面，大多数机器人（无论是刚性的还是软体的）仍然遵循“笛卡尔”方法进行设计，采用自上而下的控制方式，并且心智与身体明显分离。基于我们在生物学中观察到的原理来设计人工代理并非易事。动物和植物的组织原理依赖于形态计算，以及从松散耦合的具身代理网络中涌现出的适应性行为。 建模和控制需要全新的方法。在本文中，我们简要回顾并阐释了一些具有开创性的数学成果，这些成果多年前已发表，将信息度量与代理动力学联系起来；我们将这些成果与我们及学术界近期开发的一些方法相结合，对其相关性进行简要评述，并展望我们当前和近期的工作方向，旨在为完全或部分柔顺的人工代理的建模与控制寻找具体高效的途径，以及更深入地理解自然界中的物理智能。我们提出了一篇技术性说明，根据我们提出的框架，总结了倒立摆和被动动态行走模型的相空间体积计算。从McGeer指南针步态出发，我们引入了膝踝柔顺性、足部摇杆效应以及具有分布腿部惯性的Ruina式指南针步态。推导了标准的脚跟撞击映射，并基于状态相关的蒙特卡洛和再生核希尔伯特空间方法，用于估算可行的相空间体积\( W(\gamma) \)。我们展示了基于RKHS的方法如何实现更深入、更精细的分析。

Authors: Fabio Bonsignorio, Elisabetta Barletta, Sorin Dragomir, Francesco Esposito, Enrica Zereik

Joint-State Inference for Autonomous Excavators Using Cab-View Vision-Control Fusion RLRobot

joint-state inference vision-control fusion autonomous excavation Action Chunking with Transformers cab-view

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于驾驶室视角图像和操纵杆命令的自主挖掘机关节状态推断框架，并与基于ACT的控制策略集成实现闭环挖掘，在仿真中实现了高任务完成率和低延迟。

TLDR: This paper proposes a sensor-light joint-state inference framework for autonomous excavators using cab-view images and joystick commands, integrated with an ACT-based control policy for closed-loop excavation, achieving high task completion with low latency in simulation.

Abstract: Reliable state feedback of excavator front-end mechanisms is essential for autonomous excavation, yet retrofitting existing machines with dedicated joint sensors, external cameras, or visual markers can increase deployment and maintenance burdens. This paper proposes a closed-loop autonomous excavation framework for continuous inference of excavator joint states using onboard visual observations and control-related temporal information. The framework encodes structural cues from the current cab-view image, models short-term motion trends from historical joystick commands, and introduces a rolling state buffer for the bucket joint to preserve temporal continuity under severe occlusion. Mechanical joint-range constraints are incorporated into the learning objective to suppress infeasible estimates. The current cab-view image and inferred states are supplied to an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT)-based control policy for online action generation. Experiments in an AGX Dynamics for Unity simulation environment under diverse operating conditions evaluate joint-state inference and end-to-end task execution. Across 20 autonomous excavation trials, the framework achieved a 95% task-completion rate, with an average joint-state-inference-and-control latency of 10.11 ms per step. The bucket-joint inference achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.965 degrees. These results demonstrate a sensor-light and computationally efficient joint-state-inference approach that can support closed-loop autonomous excavation with reduced dependence on additional sensing infrastructure.

摘要（中文）：挖掘机前端机构的可靠状态反馈对于自主挖掘至关重要，然而为现有设备加装专用关节传感器、外部摄像头或视觉标记会增加部署与维护负担。本文提出了一种闭环自主挖掘框架，利用机载视觉观测与控制相关的时间信息，对挖掘机关节状态进行连续推断。该框架从当前驾驶室视角图像中编码结构线索，从历史操纵杆指令中建模短期运动趋势，并引入铲斗关节的滚动状态缓冲区，以在严重遮挡下保持时间连续性。机械关节范围约束被纳入学习目标中，以抑制不可行的估计结果。当前驾驶室视角图像与推断状态被输入至基于变换器动作分块（ACT）的控制策略中，用于在线动作生成。实验在AGX Dynamics for Unity仿真环境中在多种工况下进行，评估了关节状态推断与端到端任务执行。在20次自主挖掘试验中，该框架实现了95%的任务完成率，平均关节状态推断与控制延迟为每步10.11毫秒。铲斗关节推断的平均绝对误差（MAE）为0.965度。这些结果表明，所提出的方法具有轻传感依赖性与计算高效性，能够在减少额外传感基础设施依赖的情况下，支持闭环自主挖掘。

Authors: Junwei Li, Jian Pan, Mengchi Cai, Shuai Zhao, Xizhuo Jiang, Zheng Wang, Qing Xu, Keqiang Li, Jianqiang Wang

Ego Guidance: Enhancing Robot Policy Learning with Action-Free Human Egocentric Videos VLA

egocentric videos action-free learning future prediction robot policy VLM

简要说明：本文提出SPAR，一种基于MoT架构的方法，在预训练VLM上同时进行未来视觉状态预测和动作预测，证明无动作标注的人类第一视角视频能提升机器人策略学习与泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces SPAR, an MoT architecture that uses future visual state prediction alongside action prediction on a pretrained VLM, demonstrating that action-free human egocentric videos can improve robot policy learning and generalization.

Abstract: In this paper, we investigate how human egocentric videos can benefit robot policy learning without action supervision. Building on a pretrained VLM, we propose Shared Prediction on Action and Representation (SPAR), an MoT architecture in which future visual state prediction can provide independent and complementary learning signals alongside action prediction. We find that representations learned from egocentric videos improve downstream performance on out-of-distribution robot tasks, with further gains as video data scales. We also study the effects of objective choices and data curation, providing insights into how to leverage action-free videos for scalable robot learning.

摘要（中文）：在本文中，我们探讨了人类自我中心视频如何在无动作监督的情况下促进机器人策略学习。基于预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM），我们提出了一种动作与表征共享预测（SPAR）方法，这是一种多任务（MoT）架构，其中未来视觉状态预测能够与动作预测并行提供独立且互补的学习信号。我们发现，从自我中心视频中学到的表征能够提升机器人在分布外任务中的下游性能，且随着视频数据规模的扩大，性能进一步提升。我们还研究了目标选择和数据整理的影响，为如何利用无动作视频实现可扩展的机器人学习提供了见解。

Authors: Lin Long, Tianren Ma, Zhong Chu, Di Wu, Maosong Cao, Qixiang Ye, Junbo Zhao, Shanghang Zhang

GEMOR-GS: Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM Perception3D

3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Extrinsic Calibration Relocalization

简要说明：GEMOR-GS 提出了一种 LiDAR-惯性-视觉 SLAM 系统，通过全局外参标定优化三维高斯喷溅地图，提升建图质量，并实现稳健的在线重定位以支持机器人持续运行。

TLDR: GEMOR-GS introduces a LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM system that refines 3D Gaussian splatting maps with global extrinsic calibration, enhances mapping quality, and enables robust online relocalization for continuous robot operation.

Abstract: Photorealistic and metrically consistent world representations are a primary requirement for LiDAR--inertial--visual SLAM systems that serve robots over continuous operation. 3D Gaussian splatting makes such representations attainable by supplying an explicit, renderable, and queryable scene model. We present GEMOR-GS (Global Extrinsic-calibration-refined Mapping and Online Relocalization for 3D Gaussian-Splatting SLAM) to make the Gaussian map geometrically accurate, globally refined, and re-enterable, providing a better appearance for robot perception and decision-making. To improve the 3DGS map, the LiDAR--camera extrinsic is first estimated offline by direct-method alignment over dedicated calibration segments and reused by all following online and offline processes. Under the calibrated geometry, keyframe poses and Gaussian parameters are refined alternately under a gated differentiable-rendering and LiDAR--projection objective. The final global reconstruction is then rebuilt from the refined keyframe schema with all online constraints lifted. For the robot SLAM lifecycle, the method recovers the pose from the 3DGS map after tracking loss through an XFeat bypass map, RANSAC-PnP coarse localization, and Gaussian RGB-D warp refinement. Experiments on one self-collected and five public sequences quantify each element: the offline reconstruction wins all paired keyframes against the online map by 14.3--19.9 dB, improves PSNR by approximately 9 dB over Gaussian-LIC2, and achieves 86--100% held-out relocalization success tied to extrinsic quality. The results show that GEMOR-GS improves the geometric accuracy, appearance fidelity, and re-enterability of the 3DGS map, serving as a dependable robot world model for SLAM and downstream tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要：对于需要持续运行的机器人所依赖的LiDAR-惯性-视觉SLAM系统而言，逼真且度量一致的世界表示是一项基本要求。3D高斯泼溅通过提供显式、可渲染且可查询的场景模型，使此类表示成为可能。我们提出了GEMOR-GS（面向3D高斯泼溅SLAM的全局外参标定精化建图与在线重定位），旨在使高斯地图在几何上更加精确、全局精化且可重新进入，从而为机器人感知与决策提供更好的外观表现。为改进3DGS地图，首先通过专用标定段上的直接法对齐离线估计LiDAR-相机外参，并将其复用于所有后续的在线与离线流程。在校准几何约束下，关键帧位姿与高斯参数在门控可微渲染与LiDAR-投影目标的交替优化下得到精化。随后，在解除所有在线约束的前提下，基于精化后的关键帧架构重建最终全局地图。针对机器人SLAM全生命周期，该方法在跟踪丢失后，通过XFeat旁路地图、RANSAC-PnP粗定位和高斯RGB-D扭曲精化，从3DGS地图中恢复位姿。在自行采集的一组序列和五组公开序列上的实验对各组成部分进行了量化评估：离线重建在所有成对关键帧上优于在线地图14.3–19.9 dB，相较于Gaussian-LIC2将PSNR提升约9 dB，并在与标定质量相关的外位姿评估中实现86–100%的保留重定位成功率。结果表明，GEMOR-GS提升了3DGS地图的几何精度、外观保真度和可重进入性，可作为SLAM及下游任务中可靠的机器人世界模型。

Authors: Yuchen Yang, Ming Ding, Xinyu Wu, Hesheng Wang

DeRep: Learning Depth Representations for End-to-End Navigation in Cluttered Environments RLRobot

depth representation learning reachability supervision end-to-end navigation imitation learning reinforcement learning

简要说明：DeRep 提出了一种面向导航的表示学习方法，将局部鸟瞰图可达性监督与深度重建相结合，并在多种下游策略学习方法及四旋翼的零样本仿真到真实迁移中展示了一致的优势。

TLDR: DeRep proposes a navigation-oriented representation learning method that combines local bird's-eye-view reachability supervision with depth reconstruction, and shows consistent benefits across multiple downstream policy learning methods and zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a quadrotor.

Abstract: End-to-end navigation in cluttered environments relies on compact visual representations to support collision avoidance and goal-directed motion. Existing methods typically learn these representations jointly with the policy or through observation reconstruction, which does not explicitly specify what information the representation should preserve. Moreover, they are usually evaluated with a single downstream policy learner, although the benefit of a representation may depend on how the policy is learned. It therefore remains unclear how different representation-learning objectives affect downstream navigation performance and robustness. This work proposes DeRep, a navigation-oriented representation-learning method that combines local bird's-eye-view reachability supervision with depth reconstruction. To compare representation objectives under controlled conditions, we pretrain encoders with a common architecture and freeze them during downstream learning. We evaluate the representations using a linear policy probe, flow-matching imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with PPO. DeRep achieves the lowest linear policy probe prediction error and outperforms reconstruction alone across all six tested PPO conditions. In imitation learning, both reachability-based objectives achieve higher mean success rates than reconstruction alone, with similar mean success rates between the reachability-only and joint objectives. These results demonstrate consistent benefits of incorporating reachability supervision into depth representation pretraining across different downstream learning methods and evaluation conditions. We further deploy the PPO policy with the frozen DeRep encoder in Gazebo and on a physical quadrotor without fine-tuning, demonstrating its capability for zero-shot sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfer.

摘要（中文）：在杂乱环境中进行端到端导航依赖于紧凑的视觉表示，以支持避障和目标导向运动。现有方法通常将策略学习与观测重建联合进行表征学习，这并未明确指定表征应保留哪些信息。此外，这些方法通常仅使用单一的下游策略学习器进行评估，而表征的收益可能取决于策略的学习方式。因此，不同表征学习目标对下游导航性能和鲁棒性的影响仍不明确。本文提出DeRep，一种面向导航的表征学习方法，结合局部鸟瞰图可达性监督与深度重建。为了在受控条件下比较表征目标，我们使用统一架构预训练编码器，并在下游学习阶段冻结这些编码器。我们通过线性策略探测、流匹配模仿学习以及基于PPO的强化学习来评估表征。DeRep在六种PPO条件下均取得最低的线性策略探测预测误差，并优于仅使用重建目标的表征学习方法。在模仿学习中，基于可达性的两种目标均取得高于纯重建目标的平均成功率，且可达性单独目标与联合目标的平均成功率相近。这些结果表明，在不同下游学习方法和评估条件下，将可达性监督纳入深度表征预训练具有一致性优势。我们进一步在Gazebo仿真环境及实体四旋翼飞行器上部署冻结DeRep编码器的PPO策略，无需微调即可实现从仿真到仿真及从仿真到现实的零样本迁移。

Authors: Hanyu Jin, Kenji Shimada

ExRL: Sample-Efficient Online Adaptation of Long-Chunk Policies via Execution Length Control RLRobot

execution length control long-chunk policies sample-efficient adaptation off-policy RL robot policies

简要说明：ExRL 通过轻量级适配器预测动作块的执行长度，将强化学习自适应从高维动作空间转移到低维执行长度空间，从而在仿真和真实机器人任务中实现长块策略的高样本效率在线自适应。

TLDR: ExRL introduces a lightweight adapter to predict the execution length of predicted action chunks, shifting RL adaptation from high-dimensional action space to a low-dimensional execution-length space, enabling sample-efficient online adaptation of long-chunk robot policies in simulation and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Predicting long action chunks, often spanning dozens of timesteps, has become a key ingredient in increasingly capable robot policies. In this paper, we find that adapting these long-chunk policies with existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods can require many online samples due to the high dimensionality of the action chunks being optimized, making such adaptation impractical in real-world scenarios where interaction data are costly to collect. Our key insight is to shift adaptation from optimizing actions to optimizing how long to execute each predicted action chunk. This keeps the adaptation space low-dimensional while its expressivity grows with the chunk size. We thus introduce Execution at the Right Length (ExRL), a simple approach which augments the base policy with a lightweight adapter that predicts the execution length of each chunk and is trained using off-policy RL algorithms. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic tasks, ExRL enables sample-efficient adaptation of a diverse range of long-chunk policies with minimal task-specific hyperparameter tuning.

摘要（中文）：预测长动作片段（通常跨越数十个时间步长）已成为能力日益增强的机器人策略中的关键组成部分。在本文中，我们发现使用现有的强化学习（RL）方法对这些长片段策略进行自适应调整，往往需要大量的在线样本，原因在于被优化的动作片段具有较高的维度，这使得此类调整在真实世界场景中难以实用，因为在该类场景中交互数据的采集成本高昂。我们的关键见解在于，将调整的重点从优化动作本身转向优化每个预测动作片段的执行时长。这使得调整空间保持低维，而其表达能力随片段长度的增加而增强。为此，我们提出了“以正确时长执行”（ExRL）方法，这是一种简单而有效的方案，通过一个轻量级适配器增强基础策略，该适配器用于预测每个片段的执行时长，并采用离策略强化学习算法进行训练。在多个仿真基准测试和真实世界的机器人任务中，ExRL 能够以最少的任务特定超参数调整，实现对多种长片段策略的样本高效自适应调整。

Authors: Xu Luo, Jiaying Yang, Hao Wu, Junlin Xie, Zijin Hong, Ji Zhang, Lianli Gao, Jingkuan Song

AHEADance: Anticipatory Humanoid Dance from Streaming Audio HumanoidEmbodied

streaming dance generation humanoid robot audio forecasting whole-body tracking Commit Forcing

简要说明：AHEADance 提出了一种用于人形机器人的流式舞蹈生成器，利用对即将到来的音频的预测来同步动作块，并通过 Commit Forcing 训练从已提交块的延续，从而在 Unitree G1 机器人上实现实时舞蹈。

TLDR: AHEADance introduces a streaming dance generator for humanoid robots that uses forecasts of upcoming audio to synchronize motion chunks, and Commit Forcing to train continuation from committed chunks, enabling real-time dancing on a Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: A humanoid that dances to streamed music must commit each motion chunk before it has heard the music that chunk accompanies, and must continue from motion it has already committed. We present AHEADance, a robot-native streaming dance generator executed on a humanoid robot by a whole-body tracker. ListenAhead conditions each chunk on heard music and a frozen music model's forecasts of the coming music, aligned to their target times and weighted by reliability. The forecasts carry the timing of upcoming beats almost as well as the actual future; with them, the generator is better synchronized with the music and concentrates more motion energy at its song's beat frequency. Commit Forcing trains continuation from the model's own committed chunks, updating both the latent history and the decoded boundary of the next chunk; it reduces low activity from 83.5% to 10.3%, the level of real dance. Three music evaluators, each validated on real G1 dance, test synchronization, song and style. On a physical Unitree G1, it dances while the music plays and comes to rest when it stops, without a fall. Project page: https://ihcr.github.io/AHEADance

摘要（中文）：随着流媒体音乐起舞的人形机器人必须在听到伴随某段动作的音乐之前就确定每个动作片段，并且必须从已经确定的动作继续。我们提出了AHEADance，一种机器人原生的流式舞蹈生成器，由全身跟踪器在人形机器人上执行。ListenAhead以听到的音乐和冻结音乐模型对即将到来音乐的预测为条件，对每个片段进行条件设定，预测与目标时间对齐并按可靠性加权。这些预测几乎与真实未来一样准确地携带即将到来的节拍时机；借助它们，生成器与音乐的同步性更好，并将更多运动能量集中在歌曲的节拍频率上。Commit Forcing训练模型从自身已确定的片段继续，同时更新潜在历史和下一个片段的解码边界；它将低活动率从83.5%降低到10.3%，达到真实舞蹈的水平。三个音乐评估器，每个都在真实G1舞蹈上验证，分别测试同步性、歌曲和风格。在物理Unitree G1上，它在音乐播放时跳舞，在音乐停止时静止，且不会摔倒。项目页面：https://ihcr.github.io/AHEADance

Authors: Tianhu Peng, Yukun Wang, Lingfan Bao, Yiyang Jia, Chengxu Zhou

One Trajectory, Two Requirements: Accuracy and Local Stability in Euler Sampling for Flow Matching Policies Manipulation

flow matching policies Euler sampling stability LIBERO robot policies

简要说明：本文探讨了流匹配机器人策略中使用的固定欧拉步数能否同时满足轨迹准确性和局部稳定性的要求，通过受控实验和LIBERO案例研究表明，实际中采样受准确性限制而非稳定性限制，但端部准确性本身不能排除单独的稳定性要求。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether the fixed Euler step count used in flow matching robot policies can satisfy both trajectory accuracy and local stability requirements, showing through controlled experiments and a LIBERO case study that accuracy-limited but not stability-limited sampling occurs in practice, while also demonstrating cases where endpoint accuracy alone cannot rule out stability issues.

Abstract: Flow matching robot policies commonly use a fixed Euler step count selected from offline accuracy sweeps. At inference time, however, each policy input (visual observation, robot state, and language instruction) together with a source-noise draw defines a different ODE trajectory and sequence of local Jacobians. We ask whether a step count that accurately follows the nominal noise-to-action trajectory can still be too coarse for strongly contracting directions around it. An exact two-coordinate system and a controlled augmentation of six trained flow models show that trajectory accuracy and local Euler stability can impose different step requirements even when the original learned transport is unchanged. We then study a frozen $π_{0.5}$-LIBERO checkpoint without modifying its weights or action dynamics. Across 30 policy inputs from 10 LIBERO-10 tasks, the Jacobian exhibits strong contracting directions near the action endpoint, yet no sampled mode violates the Euler non-expansion condition. On five of those inputs, accuracy sweeps require 4--9 Euler steps at 5% terminal error and 87--112 at 1%. These five paired cases are therefore consistent with accuracy-limited rather than stability-limited sampling under this local criterion, while the controlled experiments show why endpoint accuracy alone cannot rule out a separate stability requirement.

摘要（中文）：流匹配机器人策略通常使用从离线精度扫描中选取的固定欧拉步数。然而，在推理时，每个策略输入（视觉观测、机器人状态和语言指令）与源噪声采样共同决定了不同的常微分方程轨迹及局部雅可比序列。我们探究的问题是：能够精确追踪名义噪声到动作轨迹的步数，对于其周围强收缩方向而言，是否仍然可能过于粗糙。一个精确的两坐标系统以及对六个训练流模型的受控增强实验表明，即使原始学习到的传输保持不变，轨迹精度和局部欧拉稳定性也可能提出不同的步数要求。随后，我们在不修改其权重或动作动力学的情况下，研究了一个冻结的 \( \pi_{0.5} \)-LIBERO 检查点。在来自10个LIBERO-10任务的30个策略输入中，雅可比矩阵在动作终点附近表现出强收缩方向，然而没有任何采样模式违反欧拉非膨胀条件。在其中五个输入上，精度扫描在5%终端误差时需要4—9个欧拉步，在1%误差时需要87—112个步。因此，这五组配对案例在该局部准则下与精度受限而非稳定性受限的采样一致，而受控实验则说明了为何仅凭端点精度无法排除独立的稳定性需求。

Authors: Mahindra Rautela

RaMOD: Moving-Object Detection from Raw mmWave Radar Cubes under Ego Motion AutonomousDriving

raw RAD cubes moving-object detection ego motion estimation Doppler unwrapping mmWave radar

简要说明：RaMOD 是一个实时框架，用于从车载单芯片雷达的原始毫米波雷达立方体中检测运动物体并估计速度，通过显式估计自我运动来抑制静态多普勒回波并处理多普勒模糊。

TLDR: RaMOD is a real-time framework for moving-object detection and velocity estimation from raw mmWave radar cubes on a vehicle-mounted single-chip radar, explicitly estimating ego motion to suppress static Doppler returns and handling Doppler wrapping.

Abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar provides weather-robust sensing and direct Doppler measurements, yet automotive perception pipelines often reduce its output to sparse point clouds or two-dimensional projections, leaving raw range-azimuth-Doppler (RAD) cubes underutilized. Ego motion induces Doppler responses from world-static structures, while Doppler wrapping aliases radial velocities, complicating moving-object detection and velocity estimation. We present RaMOD (Radar-based Moving-Object Detection), a real-time framework for moving-object detection and velocity estimation from raw RAD cubes acquired by a vehicle-mounted single-chip radar. RaMOD explicitly estimates frame-wise ego motion and uses the estimated radar translational velocity to predict the Doppler region of world-static structures and suppress returns within it. It temporally encodes the suppressed cubes into multi-scale features to predict RAD-space boxes with class labels. For each detected object, it predicts radial and forward velocities under raw-Doppler and Doppler-unwrapped hypotheses, together with Doppler-wrapping probabilities. On our BRIDGE-Liv dataset, RaMOD outperforms all compared raw-radar methods across RAD-cube, RA, and RD detection settings, achieving 80.8% cube mAP at IoU 0.30, 15.7 percentage points above the strongest RAD-cube baseline. Velocity MAE is 1.128 m/s, with 99.87% Doppler-wrapping accuracy.

摘要（中文）：毫米波雷达具有抗天气干扰的感知能力并可提供直接的多普勒测量，然而汽车感知流程往往仅将其输出降维为稀疏点云或二维投影，导致原始距离-方位-多普勒（RAD）数据立方体未被充分利用。自车运动会引发来自世界静态结构的多普勒响应，而多普勒卷绕会对径向速度产生混叠效应，从而增加了运动目标检测与速度估计的难度。我们提出了RaMOD（基于雷达的运动目标检测），一个从车载单芯片雷达采集的原始RAD立方体中实时检测运动目标并估计其速度的框架。RaMOD显式估计逐帧自车运动，并利用估计得到的雷达平移速度预测世界静态结构的多普勒区间，进而抑制该区间内的回波。它将对抑制后的立方体进行时间编码，提取多尺度特征，以预测带有类别标签的RAD空间目标框。针对每个检测到的目标，模型在原始多普勒与多普勒解卷绕两种假设下分别预测径向速度和前向速度，同时输出多普勒卷绕概率。在我们构建的BRIDGE-Liv数据集上，RaMOD在RAD立方体、距离-方位（RA）和距离-多普勒（RD）三种检测设置下均优于所有对比的原始雷达方法，在IoU为0.30时实现了80.8%的立方体mAP，比最强的RAD立方体基线高出15.7个百分点。速度平均绝对误差（MAE）为1.128 m/s，多普勒卷绕判断准确率达到99.87%。

Authors: Yuan Fang, Long Zhuang, Lingzi Xing, Xijia Wei, Jingqi Jiang, Fangzhan Shi, Simon Julier, Kevin Chetty

Force-Closure Condition for Cooperative Multi-robot Pushing of Rectangular Objects Manipulation

force closure multi-robot pushing rectangular object trajectory tracking wrench feasibility

简要说明：本文推导了矩形物体在多机器人协同推动下的力闭合条件，并将其作为几何可行性层集成到轨迹跟踪框架中，仿真实验表明跟踪精度显著提高。

TLDR: This paper derives a closed-form force-closure condition for cooperative multi-robot pushing of rectangular objects and integrates it into a trajectory-tracking framework as a geometric feasibility layer, demonstrating improved tracking accuracy in simulations.

Abstract: In cooperative object manipulation, the placement of pushing contacts determines whether force closure can be achieved and agents can generate arbitrary forces and torques on the object correspondingly. This study derives a necessary and sufficient closed-form condition for the planar force closure of a rectangular object, a common object shape in everyday settings, under four frictionless pushing contacts. For a rectangle of length $b$ and width $a$, force closure holds if and only if $(l_1+l_3-b)(l_2+l_4-a)<0$, where $l_1,l_2,l_3,l_4$ are the four edge contact locations. This condition is independent of the object's center of mass and is used to verify contact configurations before contact force allocation. When the condition is not satisfied, the signs of the two factors indicate which opposing contact pair should be adjusted. The condition and adjustment rule are then integrated into a full-pose trajectory-tracking framework as a geometric feasibility layer to demonstrate their use in control. Static wrench feasibility tests validate the proposed condition, while narrow-passage floating-body simulations show that maintaining a force-closure configuration reduces the RMS tracking errors in $x$, $y$, and unwrapped yaw from $12.05$ m, $18.11$ m, and $535.96^\circ$ to $2.24$ m, $2.66$ m, and $2.69^\circ$, respectively.

摘要（中文）：在协作物体操作中，推动接触点的布置决定了能否实现力闭合，以及各智能体能否相应地在该物体上产生任意力和力矩。本研究针对日常环境中常见的矩形物体，推导了在四个无摩擦推动接触点下平面力闭合的一个充要闭式条件。对于长为$b$、宽为$a$的矩形，力闭合成立当且仅当$(l_1+l_3-b)(l_2+l_4-a)<0$，其中$l_1,l_2,l_3,l_4$为四个边接触位置。该条件与物体的质心无关，并用于在接触力分配之前验证接触配置。当该条件不满足时，两个因子的符号指示应调整哪一对相对的接触点。随后，该条件及调整规则被整合进一个全位姿轨迹跟踪框架中，作为几何可行性层，以展示其在控制中的应用。静态力旋量可行性测试验证了所提出的条件，而窄通道浮体仿真表明，保持力闭合配置可将$x$、$y$及展开偏航角的均方根跟踪误差分别从$12.05$ m、$18.11$ m和$535.96^\circ$降低至$2.24$ m、$2.66$ m和$2.69^\circ$。

Authors: Duy Anh Nguyen, Trung Dung Ngo

Latent Barrier Steering: Hierarchical Safety for Generative Planning Manipulation

safe generative planning control barrier functions flow matching hierarchical safety robot planning

简要说明：本文提出了潜在势垒引导（LBS），一种用于基于流匹配的生成式规划器的分层安全框架，首先将行为潜在引导至更安全的轨迹，然后应用路径空间CBF QP处理剩余违规，在导航和操作任务中提高了安全性并改善了目标达成率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Latent Barrier Steering (LBS), a hierarchical safety framework for flow-matching-based generative planners that first steers the behavior latent toward safer rollouts and then applies a path-space CBF QP for residual violations, improving safety and goal reaching in navigation and manipulation tasks.

Abstract: We introduce Latent Barrier Steering (LBS), a hierarchical semantic-to-path framework for safe flow-matching-based generative planning. Existing control-barrier-function (CBF) safety filters for diffusion and flow-matching planners act locally on generated samples, either during sampling or after prediction. Such repair is effective for small violations, but can struggle when a new constraint blocks the whole selected behavior mode rather than merely perturbing it locally. LBS decouples behavior selection from path certification through two coordinated interventions: it first steers the generator's behavior latent toward rollouts with larger safety margin, then decodes the steered latent and applies a path-space CBF quadratic program (QP) only for residual violations. We show that latent steering increases the margin available to the path-space corrector, yielding finite-time recovery guarantees and reduced correction burden. Experiments across navigation and robot end-effector planning tasks show that LBS preserves safety while improving goal reaching and reducing correction burden compared with path-level safety filters.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了潜势屏障引导（LBS），一种面向安全流匹配生成规划的分层语义到路径框架。现有的基于控制屏障函数（CBF）的安全过滤器，在扩散和流匹配规划器中，或是在生成样本时，或是在预测之后，局部地作用于生成的样本。这种修复方式对于小的违规行为有效，但当新约束阻碍了整个选定的行为模式，而非仅仅局部扰动时，其效果可能不佳。LBS通过两种协同干预将行为选择与路径认证解耦：首先，它将生成器的行为潜势引向具有更大安全裕度的展开轨迹；然后，解码被引导的潜势，并仅对残余违规应用路径空间CBF二次规划（QP）。我们证明了潜势引导增加了路径空间校正器可用的裕度，从而实现了有限时间恢复保证并减少了校正负担。在导航和机器人末端执行器规划任务上的实验表明，与路径级安全过滤器相比，LBS在保持安全性的同时，提高了目标到达率并减少了校正负担。

Authors: Renhao Zhang, Mingzhe Li, Bruno Castro da Silva

DOBB: Dynamic Oriented Bounding Boxes for Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance under State Uncertainty and Heterogeneous Dynamics RLRobot

multi-agent collision avoidance oriented bounding boxes state uncertainty heterogeneous dynamics decentralized navigation

简要说明：本文提出动态有向包围盒（DOBB），将状态估计、不确定性和代理动态映射为方向相关的安全裕度，用于多智能体碰撞避免，在分布外偏移下保持鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Dynamic Oriented Bounding Boxes (DOBB), a geometric representation that maps state estimates, uncertainty, and agent dynamics into direction-dependent safety margins for multi-agent collision avoidance, achieving robust performance under out-of-distribution shifts.

Abstract: Learning-based decentralized collision avoidance must remain reliable under state-estimation uncertainty and heterogeneous agent dynamics. Existing methods typically address these factors through training-domain variation or by exposing uncertainty and capability estimates to the policy at runtime. However, both leave the policy to infer how these quantities should alter the physical separation required for safe interaction, which can couple collision-avoidance behavior to relationships learned from the training distribution. We introduce the Dynamic Oriented Bounding Box (DOBB), an online geometric representation that maps the current state estimate, uncertainty, and agent-specific response characteristics into a dynamic, direction-dependent safety margin. We derive geometric features that jointly characterize the relative configuration and severity of interactions between agents' DOBBs, along with a reward function that preserves the physical interpretation of those interactions. Across four evaluation environments, DOBB achieves the lowest mean total failure rate of 2.6%. This performance persists under out-of-distribution shifts in actuation dynamics and state-estimation uncertainty, with collision-based failure remaining at or below 2.3% in every tested condition. We attribute this robustness to the geometric abstraction of the safety margin, which is less coupled to the specific uncertainty and actuation regimes encountered during training.

摘要（中文）：基于学习的去中心化碰撞避免方法必须在状态估计不确定性和异构智能体动力学条件下保持可靠性。现有方法通常通过训练域变化或在运行时向策略暴露不确定性和能力估计来处理这些因素。然而，这两种方法都让策略自行推断这些量应如何改变安全交互所需的物理间距，这可能将碰撞避免行为与从训练分布中学到的关系耦合在一起。我们提出了动态定向包围盒（DOBB），这是一种在线几何表示，将当前状态估计、不确定性和智能体特定的响应特性映射为动态的、依赖方向的安全裕度。我们推导出几何特征，这些特征联合表征了智能体DOBB之间相对构型和交互的严重程度，并设计了一个保持这些交互物理含义的奖励函数。在四个评估环境中，DOBB实现了最低的平均总故障率2.6%。在驱动动力学和状态估计不确定性的分布外偏移下，该性能依然保持，所有测试条件下基于碰撞的故障率始终低于或等于2.3%。我们将这一鲁棒性归因于安全裕度的几何抽象，它与训练期间遇到的特定不确定性和驱动机制耦合程度较低。

Authors: Pedro Antonio Alarcon Granadeno, Jane Cleland-Huang

Benchmarking Real-World Robotic Manipulation through Stochastic Challenges Manipulation

stochastic challenges benchmarking mobile manipulation real-world reproducibility

简要说明：本文提出了一种称为随机挑战的新基准测试范式，用于在真实世界机器人操作中实现可复现和可比较的评估，并在不同机器人及实验室的移动操作基准上进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a new benchmarking paradigm called stochastic challenges for reproducible and comparable real-world robotic manipulation evaluation, implementing it in a mobile manipulation benchmark tested across different robots and labs.

Abstract: A challenging bottleneck in manipulation research is reproducibility and comparability of methods in real-world environments. Since manipulation is an interactive task, it cannot be evaluated on a static dataset of observations. Benchmarking in simulation is a common remedy, but cannot cover the whole complexity of real-world tests. This paper proposes a new paradigm of stochastic challenges. Like the well-known YCB objects, it is based on reproducible real-world scenes and therefore allows system-level innovation and comparability between different platforms. Due to their stochastic nature, our challenges however, mimic the rigor and surprise of hidden test sets. To this end, we show how different robots in different labs can be compared based on their success rate over different random task samples, if these samples come from the same distribution. We propose stochastic challenges as a general paradigm for robot benchmarking and implement this paradigm in a novel benchmark for mobile manipulation, on which we compare two robots tested in two different labs.

摘要（中文）：操作研究中的一个关键瓶颈是方法在真实环境中的可重复性和可比性。由于操作是一项交互性任务，无法在静态观测数据集上进行评估。仿真中的基准测试是一种常见补救措施，但无法涵盖真实世界测试的全部复杂性。本文提出了一种随机挑战的新范式。与著名的YCB物体类似，它基于可重复的真实世界场景，因而允许系统级创新及不同平台之间的可比性。然而，由于我们的挑战具有随机性，它们模拟了隐藏测试集的严谨性和不可预知性。为此，我们展示了如何基于不同随机任务样本上的成功率，对不同实验室中的不同机器人进行比较，前提是这些样本来自同一分布。我们提出将随机挑战作为机器人基准测试的通用范式，并在一个新颖的移动操作基准中实现了这一范式，在该基准上对两个不同实验室测试的两台机器人进行了比较。

Authors: Elias Gläßer, Gülhan Şikaroğlu, Pavlo Kupyn, Marc Pollefeys, Zuria Bauer, Hermann Blum

Gaussian Process-Augmented Model Predictive Contouring Control for 6-DoF Trajectory Tracking with a Holonomic AUV RLRobot

Model Predictive Contouring Control Gaussian Process AUV 6-DoF holonomic

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于高斯过程增强的模型预测轮廓控制器，用于全向自主水下航行器的六自由度轨迹跟踪，并通过仿真和水下实验进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a Gaussian Process-augmented Model Predictive Contouring Controller for 6-DoF trajectory tracking of a holonomic AUV, validated in simulation and in-water experiments.

Abstract: Small, holonomic Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) enable close-range inspection of underwater structures from arbitrary viewpoints, requiring accurate position and attitude tracking under state and input constraints. Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) naturally handles these requirements, but relies on an accurate dynamics model, which is difficult to obtain underwater. In this paper, we present a nonlinear MPCC in all six Degrees of Freedom (DoF) for a holonomic AUV and alleviate the inaccuracies in the dynamics by augmenting the nominal model employed with residual dynamics learned via Gaussian Process (GP) regression. The learned residual is embedded in the optimal control problem through a zero-order robust optimization scheme, which keeps the controller real-time capable at 25 Hz. A simulation ablation shows that residual selection is essential when designing the controller, and simulation and in-water experiments with the Multimodality, Observing, Low-cost, Agile (MOLA) AUV validate the resulting controllers against a nominal MPCC and a field proven Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controller.

摘要（中文）：小型全向自主水下机器人（AUV）能够从任意视角对水下结构进行近距离检测，这要求在状态和输入约束下实现精确的位置与姿态跟踪。模型预测轮廓控制（MPCC）天然满足这些需求，但其依赖于精确的动力学模型，而水下环境中获取此类模型颇为困难。本文针对全向AUV提出了一种六自由度（DoF）非线性MPCC方法，并通过高斯过程（GP）回归学习残差动力学，将其增广至所采用的标称模型中，以缓解动力学模型的不准确性。所学习的残差通过零阶鲁棒优化方案嵌入最优控制问题中，使控制器能够以25 Hz的频率实时运行。仿真消融研究表明，在设计控制器时残差的选择至关重要。此外，利用多模态、低成本、敏捷观测（MOLA）AUV进行的仿真与水下实验，将所提控制器与标称MPCC及经过现场验证的比例-积分-微分（PID）控制器进行了对比验证。

Authors: David Dörner, Giancarlo Troni, Ignacio Torroba, Ivan Stenius

Personalized Affective Perception via Continual Learning in Human-Agent Negotiation HumanoidEmbodied

continual learning facial expression recognition human-agent negotiation valence-arousal humanoid robot

简要说明：本文提出一种情感自适应谈判策略，通过持续学习个性化人脸表情识别（效价-唤醒度），在用户研究中使类人机器人获得更高收益和让步率。

TLDR: This paper presents an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that uses continual learning to personalize facial expression recognition (valence-arousal) for a humanoid robot, achieving higher utility and concession rates in a user study.

Abstract: Self-interested intelligent agents that negotiate with humans should interpret nonverbal expressions and adapt their behavior accordingly. However, generic facial-affect models degrade across individuals and contexts, creating a generalization gap. We introduce an affect-adaptive negotiation strategy that incorporates Continual Learning with Imagination for Facial Expression Recognition (CLIFER) to personalize valence-arousal perception in real time. Differential feedback converts changes in valence-arousal direction and intensity into adjustments of the agent's target utility. An asynchronous architecture updates CLIFER in the background during live interaction. In a counterbalanced within-subject study in which 66 participants negotiated with a humanoid robot, the CL-enabled agent achieved significantly higher individual utility and elicited higher participant concession rates than the FaceChannel baseline. The CL condition yielded significantly higher mean arousal estimates, alongside a broader output range. Participant utility and Nash distance did not change significantly between conditions. These outcomes support the practical value of coupling continual affective personalization with differential feedback for real-time negotiation.

摘要（中文）：自私的智能代理在与人类谈判时，应解读非言语表达并相应调整其行为。然而，通用面部情感模型在个体和情境间存在差异，导致泛化缺口。我们提出了一种情感自适应谈判策略，该策略融合了带有想象力的持续学习用于面部表情识别（CLIFER），以实时个性化效价-唤醒感知。差分反馈将效价-唤醒方向及强度的变化转化为代理目标效用的调整。一种异步架构在实时交互期间于后台更新CLIFER。在一项平衡的受试者内研究中，66名参与者与人形机器人进行谈判，启用持续学习的代理相比FaceChannel基线实现了显著更高的个体效用，并引发了参与者更高的让步率。持续学习条件下的平均唤醒估计显著更高，且输出范围更广。参与者效用和纳什距离在两种条件间无显著变化。这些结果支持了将持续情感个性化与差分反馈相结合用于实时谈判的实践价值。

Authors: Mehmet Onur Keskin, Berk Buzcu, Nikhil Churamani, Reyhan Aydogan, Hatice Gunes, Catholijn Jonker

Model-Free Runtime Measurement of Task-Relevant Information RLRobot

acquisition-state telemetry informational friction model-free monitoring reinforcement learning robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了一种无模型架构——采集状态遥测（AST），用于监控自主系统中持续的信息采集过程，生成进度和信息摩擦信号，并在包括机器人操作和强化学习在内的多个领域中验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Acquisition-State Telemetry (AST), a model-free architecture that monitors ongoing information acquisition in autonomous systems, emitting signals for progress and informational friction, and demonstrates its effectiveness across diverse domains including robotic manipulation and reinforcement learning.

Abstract: Autonomous systems increasingly monitor physical kinematics, environmental states and task completion outcomes. While existing work provides methods to plan information seeking actions and interpret acquired observations, current approaches do not monitor whether the live process of information gathering is functioning properly. Consequently, such systems can remain operationally active without resolving outstanding mission requirements. To address this limitation, we introduce Acquisition-State Telemetry (AST), a model free architecture that evaluates ongoing information acquisition from observable evidence relative to declared task requirements. Specifically, a domain interface maps raw observations into task resolution coordinates and normalized comparative representations, which are processed by a fixed causal monitor. This monitor emits two continuous real time signals that quantify (i) prospective progress across unresolved requirements and (ii) informational friction generated when recurrent evidence yields negligible informational gain. We evaluated a single, unadjusted monitor configuration across eight diverse domains including search and rescue dialogue, spatial grid exploration, hierarchical capability acquisition, continuous robotic manipulation, and probabilistic intent estimation. We show that across these domains the friction channel distinguished unproductive stagnation from purposeful exploration prior to task completion, while remaining muted during post completion activity. Furthermore, in closed loop reinforcement learning experiments under early termination constraints, we demonstrate that penalizing informational friction allowed agents to sustain high mission success, whereas unpenalized policies and baselines with matched operational costs failed to complete required tasks.

摘要（中文）：自主系统日益频繁地监控物理运动学、环境状态及任务完成结果。尽管现有工作提供了规划信息采集行为并解读所获观测的方法，但当前方法并未监控信息采集的实时过程是否正常运行。因此，此类系统可能在未解决关键任务要求的情况下仍保持运行活跃状态。为弥补这一局限，我们提出采集状态遥测（AST），一种无模型架构，用于根据声明的任务要求评估基于可观测证据的持续信息采集过程。具体而言，域接口将原始观测映射为任务解决坐标及归一化比较表示，并由固定因果监控器处理。该监控器输出两个连续实时信号，分别量化（i）未解决要求上的预期进展，以及（ii）当重复证据产生可忽略的信息增益时所引发的信息摩擦。我们评估了单一且未经调整的监控器配置在八个不同领域中的表现，包括搜救对话、空间网格探索、分层能力获取、连续机器人操作及概率意图估计。结果表明，在这些领域中，摩擦通道在任务完成前能够区分非生产性停滞与有目的的探索，同时在任务完成后的活动中保持静默。此外，在提前终止约束下的闭环强化学习实验中，我们证明对信息摩擦施加惩罚能够使智能体维持较高的任务成功率，而未受惩罚的策略及具有匹配操作成本的基线方法则未能完成所需任务。

Authors: Dimitris Panagopoulos, Adolfo Perrusquía, Yang Xing, Weisi Guo

HiPFuse: Real-Time LiDAR Semantic Segmentation for Robotic Perception on Edge Devices Perception3D

LiDAR semantic segmentation point-BEV fusion edge computing robotic perception real-time

简要说明：HiPFuse 提出了一种用于边缘设备上 LiDAR 语义分割的实时点-BEV 融合框架，在实现高精度和高速度的同时，提升了机器人里程计的性能。

TLDR: HiPFuse presents a real-time point-BEV fusion framework for LiDAR semantic segmentation on edge devices, achieving high accuracy and speed for robotic perception and improving downstream odometry performance.

Abstract: Real-time robotic perception requires accurate LiDAR semantics under limited resources. Bird's-eye-view (BEV) aggregation is efficient but can mix differently labeled surfaces in columns. We present HiPFuse, a point-BEV fusion framework that exchanges point and height-partitioned BEV features across horizontal scales, combining point-wise detail with 2D spatial context from one LiDAR scan. Fixed height assignments preserve separate vertical aggregation groups, with auxiliary supervision of initial BEV features using targets from the same 3D cells. A dual-scale BEV context module adds broader context from a coarser grid. On SemanticKITTI and MCD, HiPFuse achieves 63.7% and 62.5% mIoU at 14.2 and 22.4 FPS on Jetson AGX Orin, respectively, exceeding the 10 Hz scan rate. Separate training and evaluation show indoor applicability. Replacing only the baseline semantic front end with HiPFuse in fixed robotic systems reduces odometry absolute trajectory error RMSE by 10.6% on average across two outdoor sequences and increases accepted-loop recall by 8.7 percentage points on SemanticKITTI. Qualitative semantic maps show more continuous road labeling. Our code is available at https://github.com/haiyang2022/HiPFuse.

摘要（中文）：实时机器人感知要求在有限资源下实现精确的LiDAR语义理解。鸟瞰图（BEV）聚合方法高效，但可能会在垂直列中混合不同标签的表面。我们提出了HiPFuse，一种点-BEV融合框架，在水平尺度上交换点特征与高度分区的BEV特征，将单次LiDAR扫描中的逐点细节与二维空间上下文相结合。固定的高度分配保持了独立的垂直聚合组，并利用来自相同三维体素的目标对初始BEV特征进行辅助监督。双尺度BEV上下文模块从更粗的网格中引入更广泛的上下文信息。在SemanticKITTI和MCD数据集上，HiPFuse在Jetson AGX Orin平台上分别以14.2 FPS和22.4 FPS的运行速度实现了63.7%和62.5%的mIoU，均超过10 Hz的扫描频率。独立的训练与评估验证了其在室内场景中的适用性。在固定机器人系统中，仅将基线语义前端替换为HiPFuse，即在两条户外序列上将里程计绝对轨迹误差RMSE平均降低10.6%，并在SemanticKITTI上将回环检测接受召回率提升8.7个百分点。定性语义地图显示道路标注更加连续。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/haiyang2022/HiPFuse 获取。

Authors: Haiyang Wu, George Vosselman, Ville Lehtola

A computational framework for understanding embodied plans Other

embodied plans task-and-motion planning intuitive physics generative model human plan reasoning

简要说明：GenEA 是一种生成式智能体模型，结合了关节生物力学、任务与运动规划以及直观物理，用于推理多步具身计划，并在人类计划推理实验中优于启发式方法、标准TAMP和视觉语言模型。

TLDR: GenEA is a generative agent model that combines articulated-body biomechanics, task-and-motion planning, and intuitive physics to reason about multi-step embodied plans, outperforming heuristics, standard TAMP, and VLMs in human plan-reasoning experiments.

Abstract: Reasoning about people's plans and goals based on their actions is fundamental to human social interaction and essential for cooperative, embodied artificial intelligence. Formalizing this capacity in naturalistic, embodied settings has been a longstanding challenge. Here, we present GenEA, a novel agent representation capable of reasoning over multi-step, long-horizon embodied plans. At the heart of GenEA lies a multilevel state-space that couples the coarse biomechanics of an articulated body and its interactions with nearby objects by extending the task-and-motion planning framework from robotics with simulation-based intuitive physics. By embedding this state-space in a generative model, GenEA yields a joint probability distribution over goals and embodied plans. Across several experiments spanning the qualitatively distinct domains of object manipulation and navigation, featuring diverse tasks and multiple behavioral measures, we show that GenEA, through simple transformations of this joint distribution, recapitulates how humans reason about embodied plans. Crucially, GenEA consistently outperforms strong alternative models, including plausible heuristics, standard task-and-motion planning, and a state-of-the-art vision-language model. GenEA thereby offers a new perspective on the architecture of human reasoning and social cognition, suggesting that embodied artificial intelligence systems seeking to seamlessly interact with humans should adopt GenEA-like generative models of action planning.

摘要（中文）：摘要：基于人们的行动来推理其计划与目标，是人类社会互动的根本，也是具身人工智能实现协作所必需的。在自然化的具身环境中形式化这种能力，一直是一个长期挑战。在此，我们提出了GenEA，一种能够在多步骤、长时程具身计划上进行推理的新型智能体表征。GenEA的核心是一个多层次状态空间，它通过将机器人学中的任务与运动规划框架与基于模拟的直观物理相结合，将 articulated 人体的粗略生物力学与其与附近物体的交互耦合起来。通过将该状态空间嵌入生成模型，GenEA得出了关于目标和具身计划的联合概率分布。在涵盖物体操作与导航这两个性质不同领域、包含多种任务和多种行为指标的多个实验中，我们展示了GenEA通过简单变换这一联合分布，能够再现人类对具身计划的推理方式。至关重要的是，GenEA始终优于强替代模型，包括合理的启发式方法、标准任务与运动规划以及最先进的视觉语言模型。因此，GenEA为人类推理与社会认知的架构提供了新视角，表明那些寻求与人类无缝互动的具身人工智能系统应采用类似GenEA的行动规划生成模型。

Authors: Aalap D. Shah, Basil Saeed, Joshua B. Tenenbaum, Tobias Gerstenberg, Hyowon Gweon, Ilker Yildirim

Rhythmic-Semantic Co-Speech Gestures for Emotional Dialogue in Robots Other

co-speech gestures emotional dialogue social robots beat-iconic gesture generation BEAT2 dataset

简要说明：本文提出了一种面向社交机器人的情感感知共语手势系统，能根据文本和内部情感状态实时生成标志性和节拍性手势，在BEAT2数据集上训练并部署于Haru机器人，用户研究表明其手势与语音对齐性更佳。

TLDR: This paper presents an emotion-aware co-speech gesture system for social robots that generates both iconic and beat gestures in real time from text and internal emotional state, trained on the BEAT2 dataset and deployed on the Haru robot, showing improved speech-gesture alignment in a user study.

Abstract: Co-speech gestures can increase engagement and improve speech understanding. Yet, most data-driven robot systems generate either rhythmic beat-like motion or semantically meaningful iconic gestures, but not both. We present an emotion-aware rhythmic-semantic co-speech gesture system that generates iconic and beat behaviors in real time from text and the robot's internal emotional state. We formalize the task of beat-iconic gesture generation using emotion and propose lightweight models that predict iconic timing and intensity, then fill the remaining spans with emotion-conditioned beats at an appropriate intensity level. We train on the BEAT2 dataset and deploy the system on the social robot Haru. In an online user study with 60 participants, our method shows stronger speech-gesture alignment and is preferred over baseline methods.

摘要（中文）：共语手势能够提升参与感并促进言语理解。然而，大多数数据驱动的机器人系统仅能生成节奏型节拍式动作或具有语义意义的示意性手势，而非两者兼得。我们提出了一种具有情感感知能力的节奏-语义共语手势系统，能够根据文本及机器人内部情感状态实时生成示意性和节拍式行为。我们形式化了基于情感的节拍-示意性手势生成任务，并提出了轻量级模型，用于预测示意性手势的时机和强度，随后在剩余时间段内以适当强度填充由情感调节的节拍动作。我们在BEAT2数据集上进行训练，并将该系统部署于社交机器人Haru上。在一项包含60名参与者的在线用户研究中，我们的方法在言语-手势对齐方面表现更强，并且相比基线方法更受青睐。

Authors: Christian Arzate Cruz, Edwin C. Montiel-Vázquez, Stefanos Gkikas, Miguel Mejia Tobar, Randy Gomez

PneuGen: Task-Driven Agentic Co-Design of Soft Pneumatic Robots Manipulation

LLM agents soft robot design co-design finite-element simulation grasping

简要说明：PneuGen 提出了一种基于 LLM 智能体的协同设计框架，用于高效设计软体气动机器人，在抓取和形状匹配任务中优于先前的计算优化基线，并在仿真和真实实验中验证。

TLDR: PneuGen introduces an agentic co-design framework using LLM agents to efficiently design soft pneumatic robots for grasping and shape-matching tasks, validated in simulation and real-world experiments, outperforming prior computational optimization baselines.

Abstract: Task-driven design of soft robots requires the consideration of factors such as geometry, morphology, material properties, and actuation, resulting in a large and complex design space that is challenging to explore. Computational optimisation methods leverage signals from simulation to iteratively improve designs to achieve task objectives. However, these methods typically demand high computational load for both optimisation and simulation. We present PneuGen, an agentic co-design framework for soft robots that leverages Large Language Model (LLM) agents to search over the soft robot design space efficiently. A designer agent proposes design programs from a parametric component library, and a separate critic agent analyses simulation diagnostics and recommends targeted revisions. Fitted module response models provide reusable physical priors relating geometry and pressure to deformation. Design programs are automatically validated and converted into finite-element simulations, enabling iterative evaluation. Across grasping tasks on primitive shapes and challenging objects, as well as shape-matching tasks that require multi-directional planar and 3D deformation, the proposed framework significantly outperforms prior computational optimisation baselines. Ablation experiments also highlight the utility of the critic agent and the module response model in facilitating efficient design. We additionally demonstrate the agent-generated soft robot designs in real-world shape-matching and grasping tasks.

摘要（中文）：面向任务的软体机器人设计需综合考虑几何结构、形态、材料属性及驱动方式等因素，由此形成庞大且复杂的设计空间，探索难度极高。计算优化方法利用仿真信号迭代改进设计，以达成任务目标，但此类方法通常在优化与仿真两个环节均需承担高昂的计算成本。我们提出PneuGen，一种面向软体机器人的智能体协同设计框架，借助大型语言模型（LLM）智能体高效搜索软体机器人设计空间。设计师智能体基于参数化组件库提出设计方案程序，独立的评审智能体则分析仿真诊断结果并推荐有针对性的修改建议。拟合模块响应模型提供可复用的物理先验知识，建立几何与压力至变形之间的映射关系。设计方案程序经过自动验证并转换为有限元仿真，从而实现迭代评估。在基本几何形状与挑战性物体的抓取任务，以及需要多方向平面与三维变形的形状匹配任务中，所提出的框架显著优于以往的计算优化基线方法。消融实验亦凸显了评审智能体与模块响应模型在促进高效设计中的重要作用。此外，我们还在真实世界形状匹配与抓取任务中展示了智能体生成的软体机器人设计。

Authors: Shaohong Zhong, Marco Pontin, Perla Maiolino

Large Language Model Explainability for Planning Lunar Rover Trajectories under Uncertainty Other

LLM explainability lunar rover planning trajectory explanation ReAct query interface uncertainty-aware traversability

简要说明：本文提出一种基于大语言模型的交互式助手，用于解释和比较月球车轨迹规划器的输出，通过工具调用实现对规划器输出的高度忠实，辅助科学团队进行任务规划。

TLDR: This paper proposes an LLM-based interactive assistant that explains and compares lunar rover trajectories produced by a sampling-based planner, achieving high faithfulness to planner outputs via tool use, aimed at aiding science teams in mission planning.

Abstract: Planning planetary rover trajectories under probabilistic uncertainty is a multi-objective optimization problem that science teams currently iteratively solve and verify by hand. This process becomes impractical when timelines and constraints frequently shift throughout the mission planning phase. Sampling-based planners such as Monte Carlo tree search can speed up this process, but their outputs do not preserve traceability to the science objectives that justify each plan, which the science team needs to verify. We propose an interactive assistant based on a large language model (LLM) that can explain planner trajectories using domain vocabulary and re-run the planner under user-specified conditions to compare alternatives. Previous work has used LLMs inside planner decision-making loops, but we explore using them for post-planning explanation, where they are more likely to be trusted since they do not directly influence planner decisions. Our framework pairs a simulator inspired by the NASA Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover (VIPER) mission with a ReAct queryable interface that calls curated action tools and retrieval functions. We evaluate the assistant on a query bank consisting of plan comparisons, feasibility, and lookup queries. Experiments show that 90.9% of the assistant's responses are faithful to the planner's outputs, a nearly 65% improvement over zero-shot prompting of the same LLM without tool access, demonstrating the potential for trustworthy explainability of uncertainty-aware traverses with an LLM-based system.

摘要（中文）：在概率不确定性条件下规划行星巡视器轨迹是一个多目标优化问题，目前科学团队需通过人工方式迭代求解并验证。当任务规划阶段时间线和约束频繁变动时，这一过程变得不切实际。基于采样的规划方法，如蒙特卡洛树搜索，可加速该过程，但其输出无法保留对各规划方案所依据的科学目标的追溯性，而科学团队需要这些目标进行验证。我们提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的交互式辅助系统，能够使用领域词汇解释规划器轨迹，并在用户指定条件下重新运行规划器以比较不同方案。以往研究已将LLM用于规划器决策循环内部，但本研究探索将其用于规划后解释，在此场景中，由于其不直接影响规划器决策，更易获得用户信任。我们的框架将受NASA挥发物调查极地探测巡视器（VIPER）任务启发的模拟器与可查询的ReAct接口相结合，该接口调用精心设计的动作工具与检索函数。我们通过包含方案比较、可行性及查询检索问题的查询库对辅助系统进行评估。实验结果表明，辅助系统90.9%的响应忠实于规划器的输出，相比同一LLM在无工具访问条件下进行的零样本提示，提升了近65%，展示了基于LLM的系统在不确定性感知轨迹的可信解释方面的潜力。

Authors: Michelle Ho, Maximilian Adang, Zachary Booth, David E. Astle, Margaret Hansen, Edward Balaban, Mykel J. Kochenderfer

Incorporating World Models in Decision Making for Next Best View Selection in Active Sensing RLRobot

Next-Best View Selection World Models Active Sensing Sensor-return adapter Robot 3D reconstruction

简要说明：本文针对主动感知中的下一最佳视角选择问题，提出一种部署适应方法，利用有限的本地校准数据学习传感器返回适配器，以考虑测量丢失，同时保持预训练世界模型不变。在实际机器人上，该适配方法用比名义选择少60%的捕获次数实现了更高的实测表面覆盖率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a deployment adaptation method for next-best-view selection in active sensing, which learns a sensor-return adapter from limited local calibration data to account for measurement dropout, reusing a pretrained world model. The adapted method achieves higher measured surface coverage with 60% fewer captures than nominal selection on a real robot.

Abstract: Efficient robotic 3D reconstruction requires selecting views that contribute new surface measurements with few physical captures. Pretrained world models can guide this choice, but a predicted surface may not produce valid depth measurements under the operating conditions of the deployed sensor. We present a deployment adaptation methodology for next-best-view selection that learns a sensor-return adapter from limited local calibration data while keeping the pretrained predictor fixed. The adapter estimates measurement dropout over each predicted surface, allowing the selection method to favor views likely to fill gaps in the measured reconstruction. In a real-robot experiment with a structured-light sensor, the adapted method achieves higher measured surface coverage with 60% fewer captures than nominal selection. The adapted method recovers a surface region that the nominal method repeatedly targets but fails to measure. These results suggest that robots can reuse pretrained predictive models while adapting their decisions to local operating conditions in data-scarce environments.

摘要（中文）：高效的机器人三维重建需要选择能够以少量实际采集贡献新表面测量的视角。预训练的世界模型可引导此类选择，但预测出的表面在部署传感器的实际运行条件下可能无法产生有效的深度测量。我们提出了一种面向下一最佳视角选择的部署适配方法，该方法在保持预训练预测器固定不变的同时，利用有限的本地标定数据学习一个传感器返回适配器。该适配器对每个预测表面的测量缺失情况进行估计，从而使选择方法倾向于优先选取那些可能填补实测重建空白的视角。在采用结构光传感器的真实机器人实验中，适配后的方法相比常规选择方法，在减少60%采集次数的同时实现了更高的实测表面覆盖率。适配方法还能恢复常规方法反复定位却始终无法测得的表面区域。这些结果表明，机器人在数据稀缺环境下可以在复用预训练预测模型的同时，将决策适配到本地运行条件。

Authors: Nikita Sarawgi, Omey M. Manyar, Satyandra K. Gupta

ASPIRE: An Agentic System-Identification Platform for Iterative Reasoning and Exploration Other

system identification large language model agent nonlinear dynamics autonomous exploration

简要说明：ASPIRE 利用大语言模型代理自动进行非线性系统辨识，选择方法、构建闭环模型，并在移动机器人、旋转摩擦系统和实验室发酵罐等实际系统上进行验证。

TLDR: ASPIRE uses a large language model agent to automate nonlinear system identification, selecting methods, building closed-form models, and validating them on real systems including a mobile robot, a rotational friction system, and a laboratory fermenter.

Abstract: System identification requires expert decisions on the identification method, incorporation of prior physical knowledge, and model validation. We propose ASPIRE, a framework for nonlinear system identification in which a large language model agent selects and executes the identification method. ASPIRE constructs closed-form, nonlinear static or dynamic models from measured data, optionally supplemented by a system description, the intended use of the model, and physical requirements expressed formally or in natural language. Each model includes its parameters, an estimation record, an interpretation of its terms, and an error evaluated on test data inaccessible to the agent. Formal physical requirements are verified independently. ASPIRE operates autonomously or interactively, allowing the agent to ask questions and the user to request further analyses and identification rounds. We evaluate ASPIRE on three measured systems: a mobile robot, a rotational system with dry friction, and a laboratory fermenter. Each system is tested with and without a description, in five runs per task. All 30 runs delivered valid models, at a cost of 0.96 to 3.38 US dollars per run. An assessment by the authors found that, for the 30 models recommended by the agent, one per run, the interpretation of the model and the documentation of its structure selection and parameter estimation fully satisfied 132 of 150 assessed items and partly satisfied 18. The most frequent discrepancy, found in nine models, concerned inaccurate or unsupported claims about model structure selection.

摘要（中文）：系统辨识需要专家在辨识方法选择、先验物理知识的引入以及模型验证方面做出决策。我们提出了ASPIRE，一个用于非线性系统辨识的框架，在该框架中，大语言模型智能体负责选择并执行辨识方法。ASPIRE能够根据测量数据构建封闭形式的非线性静态或动态模型，并可选地辅以系统描述、模型的预期用途，以及以形式化或自然语言表达的物理要求。每个模型均包含其参数、估计记录、各项术语的解释，以及在智能体无法访问的测试数据上评估得到的误差。形式化的物理要求会得到独立验证。ASPIRE既可自主运行，也支持交互式运行，允许智能体提问，并允许用户请求进一步的分析和辨识轮次。我们在三个实测系统上对ASPIRE进行了评估：一个移动机器人、一个带有干摩擦的旋转系统，以及一个实验室发酵罐。每个系统均在有无描述两种条件下进行测试，每项任务运行五次。全部30次运行均生成了有效模型，单次运行成本为0.96至3.38美元。作者评估发现，对于智能体推荐的30个模型（每次运行一个），模型解释及其结构选择和参数估计的文档记录在150个评估项目中完全满足132项，部分满足18项。最常见的差异出现在9个模型中，主要涉及模型结构选择相关表述不准确或缺乏依据。

Authors: Erik Derner, Jiří Kubalík, Robert Babuška

DreamLander: A 6-DOF World Model based Reinforcement Learning Planetary Lander RLRobot

DreamerV3 model-based reinforcement learning 6-DOF EDL planetary landing end-to-end control

简要说明：DreamLander 将基于 DreamerV3 的模型强化学习应用于六自由度行星着陆器控制，实现了 2 米内的精确着陆和低速，仅使用传感器观测，推动了端到端进入下降着陆解决方案的发展。

TLDR: DreamLander applies DreamerV3-based model-based reinforcement learning to develop a 6-DOF planetary lander controller, achieving precise landing within 2 meters and low velocity, using only sensor observations and progressing toward end-to-end EDL solutions.

Abstract: Soft powered descent landings are becoming evermore important in the field of space exploration and scientific advancement, because of their ability to deliver mission critical payloads, both highly accurately and safely. The high efficiency restriction on planetary landings due to the severely limited fuel supply results in the need for optimal guidance trajectories and control. Model based reinforcement learning is proving to be an important tool in simplifying the highly complex process of generating optimal guidance trajectories and control. In this work, we present DreamLander, a state of the art model based reinforcement learning algorithm based on DreamerV3, to generate optimal guidance and control for a realistic 6 degree of freedom entry descent landing problem. The model based approach creates a sample efficient and highly generalizable model that can be applied to a variety of scenarios whilst maintaining a high degree of accuracy, landing within 2 meters of the designated landing zone, and with velocity norm less than 0.3 meters per second. DreamLander makes use of state sensor observations, making progress toward End-to-End solutions of the Entry Descent Landing problem.

摘要（中文）：在太空探索与科学进步领域，软动力着陆下降技术正变得日益重要，因为它能够以高度精确和安全的方式运送关键任务载荷。由于燃料供应极为有限，行星着陆对高效率的严格要求使得最优制导轨迹和控制策略成为必要。基于模型的强化学习正在被证明是简化生成最优制导轨迹和控制这一高度复杂过程的重要工具。在本研究中，我们提出了DreamLander，一种基于DreamerV3的最先进的基于模型的强化学习算法，用于为真实的六自由度进入下降着陆问题生成最优制导与控制策略。该基于模型的方法构建了一个样本高效且泛化能力强的模型，可应用于多种场景，同时保持着较高的精度——在指定着陆区2米范围内着陆，且速度范数小于每秒0.3米。DreamLander利用状态传感器观测数据，为进入下降着陆问题的端到端解决方案的实现取得了进展。

Authors: George Nehma, Patrick Quinn, Madhur Tiwari, Camilo Riano-Rios

Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning WorldModel

LLM-generated world models neuro-symbolic reasoning partially observable stochastic games mechanical validity structural agreement

简要说明：本文评估了LLM生成部分可观测随机博弈形式世界模型的能力，发现机械有效性不足以确保模型忠实代表原始决策问题。

TLDR: This paper benchmarks LLMs' ability to generate formal world models as partially observable stochastic games, finding that mechanical validity alone is insufficient for faithful representation of the intended decision problem.

Abstract: Formal world models can support planning, verification, and safety reasoning, but constructing them from open-ended natural-language situations is difficult, particularly in multi-agent settings where several formalizations may be plausible. We study whether five LLMs can generate such world models as partially observable stochastic games and whether mechanical validity is sufficient to establish that the resulting model faithfully represents the intended decision problem. We introduce a benchmark of 44 scenarios spanning game, situational, and cultural settings and evaluate generated world models along three dimensions: mechanical validity, reference-relative structural agreement, and semantic criteria. Across three empirical tracks, we analyze 410 first-pass generations. In the reference-backed game track, 134/135 generated world models pass a strict mechanical audit, yet mean permutation-invariant structural F1 is only 0.366, with just 28/134 mechanically valid models exactly matching the authored reference. In the cultural track, explicitly naming the country changes the generated structural representation for most LLMs while producing only small changes in automated semantic scores. These results show that executability is a necessary but insufficient criterion for LLM-generated world models: models that are mechanically valid can still differ substantially in the structure used by downstream neuro-symbolic reasoning and planning.

摘要（中文）：形式化世界模型可以支持规划、验证和安全性推理，但从开放式的自然语言情境中构建此类模型颇具挑战，尤其是在多智能体场景下，多种形式化方案可能均具有合理性。本文研究了五种大语言模型能否以部分可观察随机博弈的形式生成此类世界模型，以及机械有效性是否足以确保所生成的模型忠实代表预期的决策问题。我们引入了一个包含44个场景的基准测试集，涵盖博弈情境、情境设定和文化背景，并从三个维度评估生成的世界模型：机械有效性、相对于参考模型的结构一致性以及语义标准。通过三条实证路径，我们分析了410个首轮生成结果。在基于参考的博弈路径中，134/135个生成的世界模型通过了严格的机械审计，但平均置换不变结构F1分数仅为0.366，且仅有28/134个机械有效的模型与作者提供的参考模型完全匹配。在文化路径中，明确标注国家名称会使大多数大语言模型生成的结构表示发生变化，而对自动化语义分数仅产生微小影响。上述结果表明，可执行性是必要的但并非充分条件——机械有效的模型在下游神经符号推理和规划所使用的结构上仍可能存在显著差异。

Authors: Souhaila Djaffal, Amna Jamal, Gagana Madhugiri Devaraja, Anidipta Pal, Jobst Heitzig

Audited Gradients, Anchored Policies: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Flow Control RLRobot

model-based reinforcement learning action gradient surrogate audit anchor penalty flow control

简要说明：本文提出了一种审计机制，将模型预测的动作梯度与高保真求解器的估计进行比较，以决定是否信任该梯度进行策略优化，并使用锚定惩罚使策略保持在已验证的低维反馈律附近。该方法在流动控制中实现了高效控制，比无模型基线减少3至156倍的高保真求解器交互。

TLDR: This paper introduces an auditing mechanism that compares surrogate action gradients against high-fidelity solver estimates to decide whether to trust them for policy optimization, and uses an anchor penalty to keep the policy near a validated low-dimensional feedback law. The approach achieves efficient flow control with 3-156 times fewer high-fidelity solver interactions than model-free baselines.

Abstract: Feedback controllers for flows are expensive to design, since each candidate must be evaluated with a high-fidelity solver. Differentiable surrogates reduce that cost, but they also introduce a failure mode that prediction error cannot detect. Policy optimization uses the derivative of the objective with respect to the action, which we call the action gradient and which can be computed either through the surrogate or through the high-fidelity solver. Optimization through the surrogate uses only its action gradient, and a surrogate can follow the flow trajectory closely while misestimating this derivative. The surrogate action gradient is compared against a central finite-difference estimate from the high-fidelity solver on held-out states, under acceptance criteria fixed before the comparison, and we call that comparison an audit. A low-dimensional feedback law is then fitted to the surrogate action gradient when the surrogate passes the audit, and to the solver estimate when it does not. This law initializes a neural policy, and a quadratic penalty holds the policy near it during optimization. The proposed approach is validated on four test cases. The resulting controllers outperform or match a model-free baseline, while using 3 to 156 times fewer high-fidelity solver interactions across the four test cases. One surrogate predicts the objective at correlation 0.9996 but its action gradient at only 0.459, so prediction accuracy does not identify a usable surrogate. Another surrogate, whose action gradient agrees with the solver estimate at correlation 0.996, makes the objective 0.52% worse when the policy is optimized through it without the anchor penalty, so an accurate gradient alone does not provide a working controller. Finally, a surrogate that passes the audit at one fixed action fails it around the actions the deployed controller applies, so a pass is local.

摘要（中文）：反馈控制器的设计成本高昂，因为每个候选方案都必须通过高保真求解器进行评估。可微代理模型能够降低这一成本，但也引入了一种预测误差无法察觉的失效模式。策略优化依赖于目标函数对动作的导数，我们称之为动作梯度，该梯度既可通过代理模型计算，也可通过高保真求解器获得。通过代理模型进行优化仅使用其动作梯度，而代理模型即使紧密跟踪流动轨迹，也可能错误估计该导数。我们将代理模型的动作梯度与高保真求解器在保留状态上通过中心有限差分法得到的估计值进行比较，并采用比较前预先设定的接受标准，我们将这一比较过程称为审计。当代理模型通过审计时，则基于其动作梯度拟合低维反馈律；若未通过审计，则改用求解器的估计值进行拟合。该反馈律用于初始化神经策略，并在优化过程中通过二次惩罚项将其约束在策略附近。所提方法在四个测试案例上得到了验证。结果表明，所得控制器在性能上优于或持平于无模型基线方法，同时在高保真求解器交互次数上减少了3至156倍（四个测试案例分别统计）。其中，一个代理模型在目标预测上相关系数达0.9996，但其动作梯度的相关系数仅为0.459，这表明预测精度并不能识别出可用的代理模型。另一个代理模型的动作梯度与求解器估计的相关系数为0.996，但若在不施加锚定惩罚的情况下通过该模型优化策略，目标函数值反而变差0.52%，这说明仅凭精确的梯度也不足以构建有效的控制器。最后，某个代理模型在某一固定动作下通过审计，但在部署控制器实际施加的动作附近却未能通过审计，这表明审计通过具有局部性。
